decisions.choice: the temple sermon: one message from 7:1 to 8:3, given on the occasion told in chapter 26
decisions.reason: Chapter 26 tells how Jeremiah stood in the temple court early in the reign of Jehoiakim (about 609 BC) and warned that the temple would become like Shiloh (26:1-6), and how the priests and prophets wanted him put to death for it. Chapter 7 gives the sermon itself at greater length. It is prose, not poetry.

decisions.choice: the heading and the first half of verse 2 are part of the Hebrew text
alternatives: begin at "Hear the word of the LORD" (the Greek)
decisions.reason: The Greek translation (the Septuagint) has no heading here and begins at "Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah". Jeremiah in Greek is shorter in many places (see 1:1). The Hebrew is followed.

decisions.choice: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying: (L); ... from the LORD: (B); This is the message the LORD gave Jeremiah: (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this heading throughout Jeremiah.

records.literal_gloss: Stand in [the] gate of [the] house of Yahweh, and you will proclaim there the word this, and you will say: Hear [the] word of Yahweh, all Judah, the [ones] entering in the gates these to bow down to Yahweh.

en.L: "Stand in the gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and proclaim there this word, and say, 'Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all Judah, you who enter these gates to bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: "Take your stand at the gate of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and announce this word there. Say: 'Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all Judah, everyone who comes in through these gates to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: "Stand at the gate of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and announce this message there. Say: 'Listen to the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: «Ponte en la puerta de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y proclama allí esta palabra, y di: “{{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, todo Judá, los que entran por estas puertas para postrarse ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: «Colócate a la puerta de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y anuncia allí esta palabra. Di: “{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, todo Judá, todos los que entran por estas puertas para adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: «Ponte a la puerta del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y anuncia allí este mensaje. Di: “{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, gente de Judá, que entran por estas puertas para adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: « Tiens-toi à la porte de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et proclame là cette parole, et dis : “Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous tous de Juda, qui entrez par ces portes pour vous prosterner devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: « Place-toi à la porte de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et proclame là cette parole. Dis : “Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous tous, gens de Juda, qui entrez par ces portes pour adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: « Tiens-toi à la porte du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et annonce là ce message. Dis : “Écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous tous, habitants de Juda, qui passez par ces portes pour adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: "Simama katika lango la nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukatangaze huko neno hili, useme, 'Sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Yuda wote, ninyi mnaoingia kwa malango haya kumsujudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: "Simama langoni pa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukatangaze neno hili huko. Sema: 'Sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi Yuda wote, kila mmoja anayeingia kwa malango haya kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: "Simama kwenye lango la hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukatangaze ujumbe huu huko. Sema: 'Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu wote wa Yuda mnaoingia kwa malango haya kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: "Hãy đứng tại cổng nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và công bố tại đó lời này, và nói: 'Hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả Giu-đa, là những người vào qua các cổng này để quỳ lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: "Hãy đứng tại cổng nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và công bố lời này tại đó. Hãy nói: 'Hỡi toàn dân Giu-đa, là những người vào qua các cổng này để thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: "Hãy đứng tại cổng đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và loan báo sứ điệp này tại đó. Hãy nói: 'Hỡi tất cả dân Giu-đa, là những người đi qua các cổng này để thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Jeremiah from here to 8:3; the message Jeremiah is to announce runs from "Hear" to the end of verse 15
decisions.reason: God tells Jeremiah where to stand and what to say. Verses 3-15 are the words he is to proclaim to the people. From verse 16 God speaks to Jeremiah himself, and the speech goes on to 8:3.

decisions.choice: the gate of the house of the LORD: a gate into the temple courts, where worshipers came in
decisions.reason: The temple stood in courts entered through gates. In 26:2 Jeremiah stands in the temple court and speaks to the people of all the towns of Judah who come to worship, likely at a festival when crowds were there.

decisions.choice: bow down: worship
decisions.reason: The verb means to bow low to the ground, the posture of worship before God.

decisions.choice: all you people of Judah
decisions.reason: "All Judah" means the people of Judah; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "la casa del SEÑOR" (L, B); "el templo del SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets it for Spanish. God's words to Jeremiah take « », and the message he is to proclaim, from here to verse 15, takes “ ”, as the English nests its quotations.

decisions.choice: "la maison du SEIGNEUR" (L, B); "le temple du SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording of Kings and Chronicles for the temple; the sermon of 7:1-8:3 is prose, quoted with « » and “ ” as narrative speech.

decisions.choice: "nhà của CHÚA" (Literal, Balanced); "đền thờ của CHÚA" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Kings wording for the house of the LORD, as the terms note settles.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: make good your ways and your deeds, and I will let dwell you in the place this.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Make good your ways and your deeds, and I will let you dwell in this place.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Change your ways and your actions for the better, and I will let you live in this place.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Change the way you live and the things you do. Then I will let you go on living in this place.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: {{plural_you:Mejoren sus caminos y sus obras|Mejorad vuestros caminos y vuestras obras}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} haré habitar en este lugar.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: {{plural_you:Cambien para bien su conducta y sus acciones|Cambiad para bien vuestra conducta y vuestras acciones}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} dejaré vivir en este lugar.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: {{plural_you:Cambien su manera de vivir y lo que hacen|Cambiad vuestra manera de vivir y lo que hacéis}}. Entonces {{plural_you:los|os}} dejaré seguir viviendo en este lugar.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Rendez bons vos chemins et vos actions, et je vous ferai demeurer en ce lieu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Améliorez votre conduite et vos actions, et je vous laisserai habiter en ce lieu.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Changez votre façon de vivre et ce que vous faites. Alors je vous laisserai continuer à vivre en ce lieu.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Tengenezeni njia zenu na matendo yenu, nami nitawakalisha mahali hapa.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Badilisheni njia zenu na matendo yenu yawe mema, nami nitawaacha mkae mahali hapa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Badilisheni jinsi mnavyoishi na mambo mnayoyatenda. Ndipo nitawaacha mwendelee kuishi mahali hapa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Hãy sửa đổi đường lối và việc làm của các ngươi cho tốt, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi ở tại nơi này.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Hãy sửa đổi đường lối và hành động của các ngươi cho tốt hơn, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi được sống tại nơi này.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Hãy thay đổi cách sống và những việc các ngươi làm. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi tiếp tục sống tại nơi này.

decisions.choice: make good your ways and your deeds: change your conduct for the better
decisions.reason: "Ways" is the whole course of a person's life, and "deeds" the things done along it. The call is to reform how they live, not only to stop one wrong. The same words return in verse 5 and in 26:13.

decisions.choice: I will let you dwell: the Hebrew vowels make God the one who lets the people live here
alternatives: I will dwell with you in this place
decisions.reason: The written consonants could also be read "I will dwell with you in this place", which is how the Latin Vulgate takes it. The vowels of the Hebrew text give "I will let you dwell", and verse 7 continues "in the land that I gave to your fathers", which fits the people living in the land. The Hebrew vowels are followed.

decisions.choice: this place: Jerusalem with its temple, and the land
decisions.reason: In this sermon "this place" is the temple and the city (verses 6, 14, 20); verse 7 widens it to the land.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Balanced and Readable say "Armies" for "hosts" (see Isaiah 1:9).

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for "the LORD of hosts", with the span on CHÚA only (2 Kings 19:31; Samuel; Psalms); Vietnamese needs no Literal/Balanced difference here.

source.text: אַל־תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָכֶ֔ם אֶל־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not trust for yourselves in words of the falsehood, saying: [The] temple of Yahweh, [the] temple of Yahweh, [the] temple of Yahweh [are] they.

en.L: Do not trust in words of falsehood, saying, "The temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [are] these."
en.B: Do not trust in deceptive words when people say, "This is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple!"
en.R: Do not trust the lie people keep repeating: "This place is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple!"

es.L: No {{plural_you:confíen|confiéis}} en palabras de mentira, que dicen: ‘Templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [son] estos’.
es.B: No {{plural_you:confíen|confiéis}} en palabras engañosas cuando la gente dice: ‘¡Este es el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!’.
es.R: No {{plural_you:crean|creáis}} la mentira que la gente repite una y otra vez: ‘¡Este lugar es el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}!’.

fr.L: Ne vous fiez pas à des paroles de mensonge, en disant : « Le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, [ce sont] ceux-ci. »
fr.B: Ne vous fiez pas à des paroles trompeuses quand on dit : « C’est le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! »
fr.R: Ne croyez pas le mensonge que les gens répètent sans cesse : « Cet endroit est le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! »

sw.L: Msitumainie maneno ya uongo, yakisema, "Hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndiyo] haya."
sw.B: Msiyatumainie maneno ya udanganyifu watu wanaposema, "Hili ni hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!"
sw.R: Msiutumainie uongo ambao watu wanaurudia kila mara: "Mahali hapa ni hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!"

vi.L: Đừng tin cậy vào những lời giả dối, rằng: "Đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] đây."
vi.B: Đừng tin vào những lời lừa dối khi người ta nói: "Đây là đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!"
vi.R: Đừng tin vào lời dối trá mà người ta cứ lặp đi lặp lại: "Nơi này là đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!"

decisions.choice: the temple of the LORD, said three times: a slogan that treated the temple as a guarantee of safety
decisions.reason: The people repeat the words like a charm, as if God's house in their city meant he could never let the city fall. They may have remembered how Jerusalem was spared from Assyria (Isaiah 37:33-35) and the promises that God had chosen Zion (Psalm 132:13-14). Jeremiah calls this trust a lie because it ignores how they live (verses 5-11).

decisions.choice: they are: "these", pointing to the temple buildings
alternatives: these people are the temple of the LORD
decisions.reason: The sentence ends with a plural pronoun, literally "they". It points to the buildings of the temple standing before the speakers: "these are the temple of the LORD".

decisions.choice: words of falsehood: deceptive words
decisions.reason: The word means a lie or a deception, a word that cannot be relied on. It is a key word in Jeremiah (verses 8, 9; 14:14; 23:25-32).

decisions.choice: This is the LORD's temple ... (Balanced); This place is the LORD's temple ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the pointing word first, as English slogans do (m2), and use the short form "the LORD's temple" for the phrase said three times.

decisions.choice: "palabras de mentira" (L); "palabras engañosas" (B); "la mentira" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheqer as the terms note sets it for Spanish (7:4, 8). The slogan is quoted inside the message, so it takes ‘ ’.

source.text: כִּ֤י אִם־הֵיטֵיב֙ תֵּיטִ֔יבוּ אֶת־דַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־מַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֑ם אִם־עָשׂ֤וֹ תַֽעֲשׂוּ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֥ין רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For if making good you make good your ways and your deeds, if doing you do justice between a man and between his neighbor,

en.L: For if you truly make good your ways and your deeds, if you truly do justice between each one and his neighbor,
en.B: If you really change your ways and your actions for the better, if you truly treat one another with justice,
en.R: You must really change the way you live and the things you do. You must be fair to one another.

es.L: Porque si de verdad {{plural_you:mejoran sus caminos y sus obras|mejoráis vuestros caminos y vuestras obras}}, si de verdad {{plural_you:practican|practicáis}} la justicia entre cada uno y su prójimo,
es.B: Si de verdad {{plural_you:cambian para bien su conducta y sus acciones|cambiáis para bien vuestra conducta y vuestras acciones}}, si de verdad se {{plural_you:tratan|tratáis}} unos a otros con justicia,
es.R: {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que cambiar de verdad {{plural_you:su manera de vivir y lo que hacen|vuestra manera de vivir y lo que hacéis}}. {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que ser justos unos con otros.

fr.L: Car si vous rendez vraiment bons vos chemins et vos actions, si vous pratiquez vraiment le droit entre un homme et son prochain,
fr.B: Si vous améliorez vraiment votre conduite et vos actions, si vous agissez vraiment avec justice les uns envers les autres,
fr.R: Vous devez vraiment changer votre façon de vivre et ce que vous faites. Vous devez être justes les uns envers les autres.

sw.L: Kwa maana mkizitengeneza kweli njia zenu na matendo yenu, mkitenda kweli haki kati ya mtu na jirani yake,
sw.B: Mkibadilisha kweli njia zenu na matendo yenu yawe mema, mkitendeana haki kweli kila mmoja na mwenzake,
sw.R: Ni lazima mbadilishe kweli jinsi mnavyoishi na mambo mnayoyatenda. Ni lazima mtendeane haki.

vi.L: Vì nếu các ngươi thật sửa đổi đường lối và việc làm của mình cho tốt, nếu các ngươi thật thi hành công lý giữa người này với người lân cận mình,
vi.B: Nếu các ngươi thật sự thay đổi đường lối và hành động của mình cho tốt hơn, nếu các ngươi thật sự đối xử công bằng với nhau,
vi.R: Các ngươi phải thật sự thay đổi cách sống và những việc các ngươi làm. Các ngươi phải đối xử công bằng với nhau.

decisions.choice: if you truly change ... if you truly do justice: a strong condition, completed in verse 7
decisions.reason: Each verb is doubled for emphasis: "if making good you make good", "if doing you do". Verses 5-7 are one sentence: if you really change (5-6), then I will let you dwell here (7).

decisions.choice: do justice between a man and his neighbor: treat one another fairly, above all in disputes
decisions.reason: The word means a just decision, the kind given in a court case, and fair dealing in general between any two people.

decisions.choice: You must really change ... (verse 7: If you do these things, then ...)
decisions.reason: Readable gives the conditions as short commands and states the "if" in verse 7, to avoid one very long sentence.

source.text: גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְאַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְרַ֥ע לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: sojourner, fatherless and widow not you oppress, and blood innocent not you shed in the place this, and after gods other not you walk for harm to you,

en.L: [if] you do not oppress the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not walk after other gods to your own harm,
en.B: if you do not oppress the outsider, the fatherless child and the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and do not follow other gods to your own ruin,
en.R: Do not mistreat outsiders, children whose fathers have died, or widows. Do not kill innocent people in this place. Do not follow other gods, because that will only bring you harm.

es.L: [si] no {{plural_you:oprimen|oprimís}} al extranjero, al huérfano y a la viuda, y no {{plural_you:derraman|derramáis}} sangre inocente en este lugar, y no {{plural_you:andan|andáis}} tras otros dioses para {{plural_you:su propio mal|vuestro propio mal}},
es.B: si no {{plural_you:oprimen|oprimís}} al extranjero, al huérfano ni a la viuda, y no {{plural_you:derraman|derramáis}} sangre inocente en este lugar, y no {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} a otros dioses para {{plural_you:su propia ruina|vuestra propia ruina}},
es.R: No {{plural_you:maltraten|maltratéis}} a los extranjeros, a los niños que no tienen padre ni a las viudas. No {{plural_you:maten|matéis}} a gente inocente en este lugar. No {{plural_you:sigan|sigáis}} a otros dioses, porque eso solo {{plural_you:les|os}} hará daño.

fr.L: [si] vous n’opprimez pas l’immigré, l’orphelin et la veuve, et ne répandez pas le sang innocent en ce lieu, et ne marchez pas derrière d’autres dieux pour votre malheur,
fr.B: si vous n’opprimez pas l’immigré, l’orphelin et la veuve, si vous ne répandez pas le sang innocent en ce lieu et si vous ne suivez pas d’autres dieux pour votre propre ruine,
fr.R: Ne maltraitez pas les immigrés, les enfants qui n’ont plus de père, ni les veuves. Ne tuez pas des innocents en ce lieu. Ne suivez pas d’autres dieux, car cela ne vous fera que du mal.

sw.L: [kama] hamtamdhulumu mgeni, yatima na mjane, wala hamtamwaga damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa, wala hamtafuata miungu mingine kwa madhara yenu wenyewe,
sw.B: kama hamtamdhulumu mgeni, mtoto yatima na mjane, wala hamtamwaga damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa, wala hamtafuata miungu mingine kwa maangamizi yenu wenyewe,
sw.R: Msiwatendee vibaya wageni, watoto ambao baba zao wamekufa, wala wajane. Msiwaue watu wasio na hatia mahali hapa. Msifuate miungu mingine, kwa sababu hiyo itawaletea madhara tu.

vi.L: [nếu] các ngươi không áp bức khách lạ, kẻ mồ côi và người góa bụa, không làm đổ máu vô tội tại nơi này, và không đi theo các thần khác để tự chuốc lấy tai hại,
vi.B: nếu các ngươi không áp bức người ngoại kiều, trẻ mồ côi và người góa bụa, không làm đổ máu vô tội tại nơi này, và không đi theo các thần khác mà tự chuốc lấy sự hủy hoại,
vi.R: Đừng ngược đãi người ngoại kiều, trẻ mồ côi cha, hay người góa bụa. Đừng giết người vô tội tại nơi này. Đừng đi theo các thần khác, vì việc ấy chỉ gây hại cho chính các ngươi.

decisions.choice: the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow: people with no family or land to protect them
decisions.reason: A sojourner was an outsider living in Israel without land or clan; a fatherless child and a widow had no man to speak for them in court. The Law names these three again and again as people God protects (Deuteronomy 10:18; 24:17-21).

decisions.choice: shed innocent blood: put to death people who have done nothing to deserve it
decisions.reason: This covers murder, killing through unjust courts, and violence by the powerful (22:3, 17). Manasseh was remembered for filling Jerusalem with innocent blood (2 Kings 21:16; 24:4). In 19:4 the phrase is used of the children burned at Topheth (verse 31).

decisions.choice: walk after other gods: follow and worship them
decisions.reason: To walk after someone is to follow and serve them (Deuteronomy 6:14). The words "to your own harm" show that it is the people themselves who will suffer for it.

decisions.choice: sojourner (L); outsider (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word. "Foreigner" is kept for a different word, one who has no settled place in Israel.

decisions.choice: the fatherless child (B); children whose fathers have died (R)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 1:17: Balanced and Readable say plainly who the fatherless are.

decisions.choice: "el extranjero" (L, B); "los extranjeros" (R); "el huérfano" (L, B); "los niños que no tienen padre" (R)
decisions.reason: The sojourner is the foreigner living in Israel; "extranjero" is the usual Spanish word. Readable explains the fatherless, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mgeni
decisions.reason: "Mgeni" is the foreigner living among the people without land of his own, as in the Pentateuch's laws; Swahili needs no separate word for the English "sojourner" and "outsider".

decisions.choice: "l’immigré" for *ger* at every level, for the whole book
decisions.reason: "L’étranger" stays for the foreigner (*nokri*), as the English keeps "outsider" and "foreigner" apart; the French Pentateuch has both words for *ger*.

decisions.choice: "khách lạ" (Literal); "người ngoại kiều" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The ger is a foreigner living in Israel without family land; Balanced and Readable name him plainly, as the English "outsider" does.

source.text: וְשִׁכַּנְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם לְמִן־עוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and I will let dwell you in the place this, in the land which I gave to your fathers from antiquity and until perpetuity.

en.L: then I will let you dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers from of old and forever.
en.B: then I will let you go on living here in this place, in the land I gave your ancestors long ago, for all time.
en.R: If you do these things, I will let you live in this place. This is the land I gave your ancestors long ago, to be theirs forever.

es.L: entonces {{plural_you:los|os}} haré habitar en este lugar, en la tierra que di a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} desde siempre y para siempre.
es.B: entonces {{plural_you:los|os}} dejaré seguir viviendo aquí, en este lugar, en la tierra que di a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} hace mucho tiempo, para siempre.
es.R: Si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} estas cosas, {{plural_you:los|os}} dejaré vivir en este lugar. Esta es la tierra que di a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} hace mucho tiempo, para que fuera suya para siempre.

fr.L: alors je vous ferai demeurer en ce lieu, dans le pays que j’ai donné à vos pères depuis toujours et pour toujours.
fr.B: alors je vous laisserai habiter en ce lieu, dans le pays que j’ai donné à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} il y a longtemps, pour toujours.
fr.R: Si vous faites tout cela, je vous laisserai vivre en ce lieu. C’est le pays que j’ai donné à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} il y a longtemps, pour qu’il soit à eux pour toujours.

sw.L: ndipo nitawakalisha mahali hapa, katika nchi niliyowapa baba zenu tangu zamani hata milele.
sw.B: ndipo nitawaacha mwendelee kuishi hapa mahali hapa, katika nchi niliyowapa babu zenu zamani, iwe yao milele.
sw.R: Mkifanya mambo haya, nitawaacha muishi mahali hapa. Hii ndiyo nchi niliyowapa babu zenu zamani, iwe yao milele.

vi.L: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi ở tại nơi này, trong xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ phụ các ngươi từ xưa cho đến đời đời.
vi.B: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi được tiếp tục sống tại nơi này, trong xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên các ngươi từ lâu, mãi mãi.
vi.R: Nếu các ngươi làm những điều này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các ngươi sống tại nơi này. Đây là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên các ngươi từ lâu, để thuộc về họ mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: from of old and forever: describes the gift of the land
alternatives: I will let you dwell ... forever
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely goes with "I gave": the land was given to the ancestors long ago, to be theirs for all time. It could also go with "I will let you dwell": the people could live there forever. Either way, the promise depends on the conditions of verses 5-6.

decisions.choice: I will let you dwell: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the Hebrew vowels make this "I will let you dwell", not "I will dwell with you".

decisions.choice: fathers (L); ancestors (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means the earlier generations of the people, women as well as men. Literal keeps "fathers"; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors". The same holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: If you do these things
decisions.reason: Readable states the condition from verses 5-6 here (see verse 5).

decisions.choice: "ancêtres" with "pères" as the gender setting's alternative
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" without a setting; French offers "pères" as the traditional alternative, as for "the fathers" elsewhere in the French Old Testament.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (Literal); "tổ tiên" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the English moves from "fathers" to "ancestors"; Vietnamese "tổ tiên" already includes both men and women, so no gender span is needed.

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשָּׁ֑קֶר לְבִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, you [are] trusting for yourselves in words of the falsehood, to not profit.

en.L: Look, you are trusting in words of falsehood that do not profit.
en.B: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.
en.R: But look at you! You trust in lies that cannot help you.

es.L: He aquí, {{plural_you:ustedes confían|vosotros confiáis}} en palabras de mentira que no aprovechan.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{plural_you:confían|confiáis}} en palabras engañosas que no sirven de nada.
es.R: ¡Pero {{plural_you:mírense|miraos}}! {{plural_you:Confían|Confiáis}} en mentiras que no pueden {{plural_you:ayudarlos|ayudaros}}.

fr.L: Voici, vous vous fiez à des paroles de mensonge qui ne servent à rien.
fr.B: Mais voici que vous vous fiez à des paroles trompeuses qui ne valent rien.
fr.R: Mais regardez-vous ! Vous croyez des mensonges qui ne peuvent pas vous aider.

sw.L: Tazama, mnayatumainia maneno ya uongo yasiyofaidia.
sw.B: Lakini tazama, mnayatumainia maneno ya udanganyifu yasiyofaa kitu.
sw.R: Lakini jiangalieni! Mnautumainia uongo usioweza kuwasaidia.

vi.L: Kìa, các ngươi đang tin cậy vào những lời giả dối vô ích.
vi.B: Nhưng kìa, các ngươi đang tin vào những lời lừa dối chẳng có giá trị gì.
vi.R: Nhưng hãy xem các ngươi kìa! Các ngươi tin vào những lời dối trá chẳng giúp gì được các ngươi.

decisions.choice: that do not profit: that cannot help or save
decisions.reason: The same verb describes worthless gods in 2:8, 11. The temple slogan of verse 4 will not save them.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the contrast between what God asks (verses 5-7) and what the people actually do.

source.text: הֲגָנֹ֤ב׀רָצֹ֨חַ֙ וְֽנָאֹ֔ףוְהִשָּׁבֵ֥עַ לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר וְקַטֵּ֣ר לַבָּ֑עַל וְהָלֹ֗ךְ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Will stealing, murdering and committing adultery, and swearing to the falsehood, and burning incense to the Baal, and walking after gods other which not you have known,

en.L: Will [you] steal, murder and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
en.B: Will you steal and murder and commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods you have never known,
en.R: You steal, murder and commit adultery. You swear oaths that are lies. You burn incense to the god Baal and follow other gods you never knew before.

es.L: ¿{{plural_you:Robarán, matarán y cometerán|Robaréis, mataréis y cometeréis}} adulterio, y {{plural_you:jurarán|juraréis}} en falso, y {{plural_you:quemarán|quemaréis}} incienso a Baal, y {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} tras otros dioses que no {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}},
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Van a robar, matar y cometer|Vais a robar, matar y cometer}} adulterio, jurar en falso, quemar incienso a Baal y seguir a otros dioses que nunca {{plural_you:han conocido|habéis conocido}},
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes roban, matan y cometen|Vosotros robáis, matáis y cometéis}} adulterio. {{plural_you:Hacen|Hacéis}} juramentos que son mentira. {{plural_you:Queman|Quemáis}} incienso al dios Baal y {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} a otros dioses que nunca antes {{plural_you:conocieron|conocisteis}}.

fr.L: Quoi ! voler, tuer et commettre l’adultère, jurer faussement, brûler de l’encens à Baal, et marcher derrière d’autres dieux que vous ne connaissiez pas,
fr.B: Allez-vous voler, tuer, commettre l’adultère, jurer faussement, brûler de l’encens à Baal et suivre d’autres dieux que vous n’avez jamais connus,
fr.R: Vous volez, vous tuez et vous commettez l’adultère. Vous faites des serments qui sont des mensonges. Vous brûlez de l’encens pour le dieu Baal et vous suivez d’autres dieux que vous ne connaissiez pas avant.

sw.L: Je, mtaiba, mtaua na kuzini, na kuapa kwa uongo, na kumfukizia Baali uvumba, na kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua,
sw.B: Je, mtaiba na kuua na kuzini, kuapa kwa uongo, kumfukizia Baali uvumba, na kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuwahi kuijua,
sw.R: Mnaiba, mnaua na kuzini. Mnaapa viapo vya uongo. Mnamfukizia uvumba mungu Baali na kufuata miungu mingine ambayo hamkuijua hapo kwanza.

vi.L: Các ngươi trộm cắp, giết người, phạm tội ngoại tình, thề dối, đốt hương cho Ba-anh, và đi theo các thần khác mà các ngươi không hề biết,
vi.B: Các ngươi trộm cắp, giết người, phạm tội ngoại tình, thề dối, đốt hương cho Ba-anh, và đi theo các thần khác các ngươi chưa từng biết,
vi.R: Các ngươi trộm cắp, giết người và phạm tội ngoại tình. Các ngươi thề dối. Các ngươi đốt hương cho thần Ba-anh và đi theo các thần khác mà trước đây các ngươi chưa từng biết.

decisions.choice: will you steal, murder ...: an indignant question that runs on into verse 10
decisions.reason: The verbs are bare infinitives strung together after a question word, as if God can hardly finish the list. The question is completed in verse 10: will you do all this and then come and stand before me?

decisions.choice: steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, other gods: the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: The list follows the commandments (Exodus 20:3, 13-16), much as Hosea 4:2 does. The people break the covenant's basic laws and still count on its temple.

decisions.choice: burn incense to Baal: make offerings to the Canaanite storm god
decisions.reason: Burning incense or other offerings so that the smoke rose was an act of worship. Baal was the chief god of Canaan, worshiped as the giver of rain and crops.

decisions.choice: other gods that you have not known: gods who had never done anything for them
decisions.reason: Israel knew the LORD through what he had done for them (Deuteronomy 11:2-7). These gods had no such history with them (Deuteronomy 11:28; 32:17).

decisions.choice: You steal ... (verse 10: Do you think ...?)
decisions.reason: Readable states the deeds and puts the question in verse 10.

source.text: וּבָאתֶ֞ם וַעֲמַדְתֶּ֣ם לְפָנַ֗י בַּבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִקְרָא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֔יו וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם נִצַּ֑לְנוּ לְמַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: and you come and you stand before me in the house this, which is called my name on it, and you say, We are delivered, so as to do all the abominations these?

en.L: and [then] come and stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in this house, which is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and say, "We are delivered!" so as to do all these abominations?
en.B: and then come and stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in this house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name and say, "We are safe!", only to go on doing all these detestable things?
en.R: Then you come and stand in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in this temple that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and you say, "We are safe!" Do you think you are safe, so that you can keep on doing all these disgusting things?

es.L: y luego {{plural_you:vendrán y se pondrán|vendréis y os pondréis}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en esta casa, que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}}: ‘¡Estamos a salvo!’, para seguir haciendo todas estas abominaciones?
es.B: y luego {{plural_you:venir a ponerse|venir a poneros}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en esta casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre y decir: ‘¡Estamos a salvo!’, solo para seguir haciendo todas estas cosas detestables?
es.R: Luego {{plural_you:vienen y se paran|venís y os paráis}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en este templo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: ‘¡Estamos a salvo!’. ¿{{plural_you:Creen que están|Creéis que estáis}} a salvo para poder seguir haciendo todas estas cosas repugnantes?

fr.L: et [puis] venir et vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans cette maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué, et dire : « Nous sommes délivrés ! », pour faire toutes ces abominations ?
fr.B: et ensuite venir vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans cette maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et dire : « Nous sommes en sécurité ! », pour continuer à faire toutes ces choses détestables ?
fr.R: Ensuite, vous venez vous présenter devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans ce temple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et vous dites : « Nous sommes en sécurité ! » Pensez-vous être en sécurité, pour pouvoir continuer à faire toutes ces choses dégoûtantes ?

sw.L: kisha mje na kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nyumba hii, iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, na kusema, "Tumeokolewa!" ili mpate kufanya machukizo haya yote?
sw.B: kisha mje mkasimame mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika nyumba hii inayoitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na kusema, "Tuko salama!", ili tu mwendelee kufanya mambo haya yote ya kuchukiza?
sw.R: Kisha mnakuja na kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika hekalu hili linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, na kusema, "Tuko salama!" Je, mnadhani mko salama, ili mwendelee kufanya mambo haya yote ya kuchukiza?

vi.L: rồi [lại] đến đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong nhà này, là nhà được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mà nói: "Chúng ta được giải cứu rồi!" để làm tất cả những điều ghê tởm này sao?
vi.B: rồi lại đến đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong nhà này, nhà mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, mà nói: "Chúng ta được an toàn rồi!", để rồi tiếp tục làm mọi điều ghê tởm ấy sao?
vi.R: Rồi các ngươi đến đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong đền thờ mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} này mà nói: "Chúng ta được an toàn rồi!" Các ngươi tưởng mình được an toàn để cứ tiếp tục làm mọi điều ghê tởm ấy sao?

decisions.choice: the house called by my name: the house that belongs to God
decisions.reason: To have someone's name called over a thing marks it as theirs (2 Samuel 12:28). Solomon prayed that all peoples would know that this house was called by God's name (1 Kings 8:43).

decisions.choice: we are delivered, so as to do all these abominations: they treat the temple as a place of safety that leaves them free to go on sinning
decisions.reason: "We are delivered" is their claim that they are safe because they worship here. The words "so as to do" show the result: the sense of safety becomes a license to keep doing the same things.

decisions.choice: abominations: things God finds detestable
decisions.reason: The word is used above all for idol worship and other acts that God hates (Deuteronomy 12:31; 18:9-12).

decisions.choice: this house that bears my name
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the idiom in natural English; Literal keeps "called by my name".

decisions.choice: Do you think you are safe ...?
decisions.reason: Readable puts the question of verses 9-10 here (see verse 9).

decisions.choice: "llamada por mi nombre" (L); "lleva mi nombre" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The house called by God's name is the house that belongs to him; Balanced and Readable say it bears his name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "sur laquelle mon nom est invoqué" (L); "qui porte mon nom" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the old French idiom for a thing called by God's name; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

source.text: הַמְעָרַ֣ת פָּרִצִ֗ים הָיָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת הַזֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָֽא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם גַּ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה רָאִ֖יתִי נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: A den of robbers has become the house this, which is called my name on it, in your eyes? Also I, look, I have seen, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: Has this house, which is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? I too, look, I have seen [it], declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Has this house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name become a hideout for robbers in your eyes? I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} have seen it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do you think this temple that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is a place where robbers hide? I have seen what you are doing, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¿Se ha convertido esta casa, que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, en guarida de bandidos a {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}? También yo, he aquí, lo he visto, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¿Se ha convertido esta casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre en una guarida de bandidos a {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}? Yo mismo lo he visto, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que este templo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre es un escondite de bandidos? Yo he visto lo que {{plural_you:están haciendo|estáis haciendo}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Cette maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué est-elle devenue une caverne de brigands à vos yeux ? Moi aussi, voici, je [l’]ai vu, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Cette maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est-elle devenue à vos yeux un repaire de bandits ? Moi-même, je l’ai vu, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Pensez-vous que ce temple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est une cachette pour les voleurs ? J’ai vu ce que vous faites, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Je, nyumba hii, iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, imekuwa pango la wanyang'anyi machoni penu? Mimi pia, tazama, nimeona [hayo], asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Je, nyumba hii inayoitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} imekuwa maficho ya wanyang'anyi machoni penu? Mimi {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} nimeyaona hayo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Je, mnadhani hekalu hili linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ni mahali wanyang'anyi wanapojificha? Nimeona mnayoyatenda, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Nhà này, là nhà được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đã trở thành hang trộm cướp trong mắt các ngươi sao? Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa, kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thấy [điều đó], {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Nhà mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} này đã trở thành sào huyệt của bọn cướp trong mắt các ngươi sao? Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thấy điều đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Các ngươi nghĩ đền thờ mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} này là nơi bọn cướp ẩn náu sao? Ta đã thấy những gì các ngươi đang làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: a den of robbers: a cave where bandits hide and feel safe between raids
decisions.reason: The word for robbers means violent men who break in and plunder. Their cave is not where they commit crimes but where they shelter afterward. The people treat the temple the same way, as a refuge after doing wrong (verses 9-10).

decisions.choice: quoted by Jesus in the temple (Matthew 21:13; Mark 11:17)
decisions.reason: When Jesus drove the traders out of the temple courts, he joined Isaiah 56:7, "my house will be called a house of prayer", to these words of Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: I too have seen it: God is not deceived
decisions.reason: "I" is stressed. The people may see the temple as their hiding place, but God has seen what they do and who they are.

decisions.choice: a hideout for robbers (B); a place where robbers hide (R)
decisions.reason: As this translation renders Matthew 21:13, so that a reader sees the quotation.

decisions.choice: "guarida de bandidos"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it, the wording of Matthew 21:13 as published, so that the reader hears the verse Jesus quoted in the temple.

decisions.choice: pango la wanyang'anyi (Literal); maficho ya wanyang'anyi (Balanced); mahali wanyang'anyi wanapojificha (Readable)
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in the temple (Matthew 21:13; Mark 11:17); Literal keeps the key words "pango" and "wanyang'anyi" so the quotation can be recognized.

decisions.choice: "une caverne de brigands" (L); "un repaire de bandits" (B); "une cachette pour les voleurs" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the French Matthew 21:13 at each level, so that a reader sees the words Jesus quotes in the temple.

decisions.choice: "hang trộm cướp" (Literal); "sào huyệt của bọn cướp" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes these words in the temple (Matthew 21:13; Mark 11:17); the published Gospel wordings are reused so the quotation can be recognised.

source.text: כִּ֣י לְכוּ־נָ֗א אֶל־מְקוֹמִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשִׁיל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכַּ֧נְתִּֽי שְׁמִ֛י שָׁ֖ם בָּרִֽאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּרְאוּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי ל֔וֹ מִפְּנֵ֕י רָעַ֖ת עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For go now to my place which [was] in Shiloh, where I made dwell my name there at the first, and see what I did to it because of [the] evil of my people Israel.

en.L: For go now to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place that [was] in Shiloh, where I made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name dwell at first, and see what I did to it because of the evil of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.B: Go now to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place in Shiloh, where I first made {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name dwell, and look at what I did to it on account of the wickedness of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.R: Go to Shiloh, where I first chose a place for people to worship {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. See what I did to it because of the evil things {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel did.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:vayan|id}} ahora a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar que [estaba] en Silo, donde hice habitar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre al principio, y {{plural_you:vean|ved}} lo que le hice por la maldad de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} ahora a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar en Silo, donde al principio hice habitar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}} lo que le hice a causa de la maldad de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} a Silo, donde al principio escogí un lugar para que la gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} adorara. {{plural_you:Vean|Ved}} lo que le hice por las maldades que hizo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: Car allez donc à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} lieu qui [était] à Silo, où j’ai fait demeurer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom au commencement, et voyez ce que je lui ai fait à cause de la méchanceté de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.B: Allez donc à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire de Silo, où j’avais d’abord fait demeurer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et voyez ce que je lui ai fait à cause de la méchanceté de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Allez à Silo, où j’avais d’abord choisi un lieu pour que les gens {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}adorent. Voyez ce que je lui ai fait à cause du mal qu’a fait {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.

sw.L: Kwa maana nendeni sasa mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} palipokuwa Shilo, nilipolikalisha jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} hapo kwanza, mkaone nilivyopatendea kwa sababu ya uovu wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.B: Nendeni sasa mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} huko Shilo, nilipolikalisha jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} mara ya kwanza, mkaangalie nilivyopatendea kwa sababu ya uovu wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.R: Nendeni Shilo, mahali nilipochagua kwanza watu waniabudu. Oneni nilivyopatendea kwa sababu ya mambo maovu waliyoyatenda watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

vi.L: Vậy hãy đi đến nơi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [đã có] tại Si-lô, là nơi lúc ban đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự, và xem điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho nó vì sự gian ác của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Vậy hãy đến nơi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tại Si-lô, nơi lúc đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự, và xem điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho nó vì sự gian ác của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Hãy đi đến Si-lô, là nơi đầu tiên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn để dân chúng thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy xem điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho nơi ấy vì những việc ác của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

decisions.choice: Shiloh: where the tabernacle and the ark stood before the temple, and where God let disaster fall
decisions.reason: Shiloh, about twenty miles north of Jerusalem, was the place of worship in the days of Joshua and Eli (Joshua 18:1; 1 Samuel 1:3). Because of the sins of Eli's sons the ark was captured by the Philistines and Israel was defeated (1 Samuel 4). Psalm 78:60 says God abandoned his dwelling at Shiloh. In Jeremiah's day it lay in ruins (26:6, 9).

decisions.choice: where I made my name dwell: the place God chose for his worship
decisions.reason: The phrase comes from Deuteronomy 12:11: God would choose a place to make his name dwell, a place where he would be present and be worshiped. Shiloh was that place first; Jerusalem came after it.

decisions.choice: evil: the wickedness of the people
decisions.reason: The same word can mean disaster, but here it is the wrong the people did, which brought disaster on Shiloh.

decisions.choice: where I first chose a place for people to worship me
decisions.reason: Readable says what "made my name dwell" meant.

decisions.choice: "Silo"
decisions.reason: Shiloh in its published Spanish form (1 Samuel 1:3).

decisions.choice: "Silo"
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the name, as in the French Samuel.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה יַ֧עַן עֲשׂוֹתְכֶ֛ם אֶת־כָּל־הַמַּֽעֲשִׂ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וָאֲדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיכֶ֜ם הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם וְדַבֵּר֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם וָאֶקְרָ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עֲנִיתֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, because doing you all the deeds these, declaration of Yahweh, and I spoke to you rising early and speaking and not you listened, and I called you and not you answered,

en.L: And now, because you have done all these deeds, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and I spoke to you, rising early and speaking, and you did not listen, and I called you, and you did not answer,
en.B: And now, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because you have done all these things, and I spoke to you again and again and you would not listen, and I called you and you did not answer,
en.R: You have done all these things, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I spoke to you over and over, but you would not listen. I called to you, but you did not answer.

es.L: Y ahora, por cuanto {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} todas estas obras, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} hablé, madrugando y hablando, y no {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} llamé, y no {{plural_you:respondieron|respondisteis}},
es.B: Y ahora, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por cuanto {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}} todas estas cosas, y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} hablé una y otra vez y no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} escuchar, y {{plural_you:los|os}} llamé y no {{plural_you:respondieron|respondisteis}},
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han hecho|Vosotros habéis hecho}} todas estas cosas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} hablé una y otra vez, pero no {{plural_you:quisieron|quisisteis}} escuchar. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llamé, pero no {{plural_you:respondieron|respondisteis}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, parce que vous avez fait toutes ces actions, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et que je vous ai parlé, me levant de bonne heure et parlant, et que vous n’avez pas écouté, et que je vous ai appelés, et que vous n’avez pas répondu,
fr.B: Et maintenant, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que vous avez fait toutes ces choses, que je vous ai parlé sans relâche sans que vous écoutiez, et que je vous ai appelés sans que vous répondiez,
fr.R: Vous avez fait toutes ces choses, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je vous ai parlé encore et encore, mais vous n’avez pas voulu écouter. Je vous ai appelés, mais vous n’avez pas répondu.

sw.L: Na sasa, kwa sababu mmetenda matendo haya yote, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nikasema nanyi, nikiamka mapema na kusema, lakini hamkusikiliza, nami nikawaita, lakini hamkuitika,
sw.B: Na sasa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu mmetenda mambo haya yote, nami nikasema nanyi tena na tena lakini hamkutaka kusikiliza, nikawaita lakini hamkuitika,
sw.R: Mmetenda mambo haya yote, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nilisema nanyi mara nyingi sana, lakini hamkutaka kusikiliza. Niliwaita, lakini hamkuitika.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, vì các ngươi đã làm tất cả những việc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với các ngươi, dậy sớm mà nói, nhưng các ngươi không nghe, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi các ngươi, nhưng các ngươi không trả lời,
vi.B: Và bây giờ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, vì các ngươi đã làm mọi điều ấy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã nói với các ngươi hết lần này đến lần khác mà các ngươi không chịu nghe, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã gọi mà các ngươi không trả lời,
vi.R: Các ngươi đã làm tất cả những điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta đã nói với các ngươi nhiều lần, nhưng các ngươi không chịu nghe. Ta đã gọi các ngươi, nhưng các ngươi không trả lời.

decisions.choice: rising early and speaking: speaking again and again, without giving up
decisions.reason: To rise early is to start the day's work at once and keep at it. Jeremiah uses the phrase often of God's untiring warnings through his prophets (verse 25; 11:7; 25:3-4).

decisions.choice: because you have done ... and did not listen ... and did not answer: the reasons for what follows in verse 14
decisions.reason: The sentence gives the grounds for judgment: the people's deeds, and their refusal to hear when God spoke and called. Verse 14 states the judgment.

decisions.choice: rising early and speaking (L); again and again (B); over and over (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase throughout Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "madrugando y hablando" (L); "una y otra vez" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Rising early and speaking as the terms note sets it for Spanish, kept wherever it returns in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: nikiamka mapema na kusema (Literal); tena na tena (Balanced); mara nyingi sana (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording of "rising early and speaking", as the terms note sets it.

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי לַבַּ֣יִת׀אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא־שְׁמִ֣י עָלָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים בּ֔וֹ וְלַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְשִׁלֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and I will do to the house which is called my name on it, which you [are] trusting in it, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as which I did to Shiloh.

en.L: then I will do to the house that is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, in which you trust, and to the place that I gave to you and to your fathers, just as I did to Shiloh.
en.B: so I will do to this house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, the house you trust in, and to the place I gave you and your ancestors, what I did to Shiloh.
en.R: So I will do to this temple what I did to Shiloh. It bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and you trust in it. I will do the same to the place I gave to you and your ancestors.

es.L: haré a la casa que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, en la que {{plural_you:confían|confiáis}}, y al lugar que {{plural_you:les|os}} di a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}}, tal como hice a Silo.
es.B: por eso haré con esta casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, la casa en la que {{plural_you:confían|confiáis}}, y con el lugar que {{plural_you:les|os}} di a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}, lo mismo que hice con Silo.
es.R: Por eso haré con este templo lo que hice con Silo. Lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y {{plural_you:ustedes confían|vosotros confiáis}} en él. Haré lo mismo con el lugar que {{plural_you:les|os}} di a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}}.

fr.L: je ferai à la maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué, en laquelle vous vous confiez, et au lieu que je vous ai donné, à vous et à vos pères, comme j’ai fait à Silo.
fr.B: je traiterai cette maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, la maison en laquelle vous mettez votre confiance, et le lieu que je vous ai donné, à vous et à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, comme j’ai traité Silo.
fr.R: Alors je ferai à ce temple ce que j’ai fait à Silo. Il porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et vous mettez votre confiance en lui. Je ferai la même chose au lieu que je vous ai donné, à vous et à vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

sw.L: basi nitaitendea nyumba hii iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, mnayoitumainia, na mahali nilipowapa ninyi na baba zenu, kama nilivyoutendea Shilo.
sw.B: kwa hiyo nitaitendea nyumba hii inayoitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nyumba mnayoitumainia, na mahali nilipowapa ninyi na babu zenu, yale niliyoutendea Shilo.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitalitendea hekalu hili yale niliyoutendea Shilo. Linaitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nanyi mnalitumainia. Nitapatendea vivyo hivyo mahali nilipowapa ninyi na babu zenu.

vi.L: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nhà được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là nhà các ngươi tin cậy, và cho nơi mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho các ngươi và tổ phụ các ngươi, y như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho Si-lô.
vi.B: nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho nhà mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} này, là nhà các ngươi tin cậy, và cho nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi, điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho Si-lô.
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho đền thờ này điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho Si-lô. Đền thờ ấy mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và các ngươi tin cậy nó. Ta cũng sẽ làm như vậy cho nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho các ngươi và tổ tiên các ngươi.

decisions.choice: I will do to the house as I did to Shiloh: the temple itself will be destroyed
decisions.reason: The temple they trusted would not save them; God would let it fall as Shiloh fell. The Babylonians burned it in 586 BC (2 Kings 25:9). When Jeremiah said this, the priests and prophets called for his death (26:6-11).

decisions.choice: the place that I gave to you and your fathers: Jerusalem and the land
decisions.reason: As in verses 3 and 7, "place" reaches beyond the temple to the city and the land given to the people.

decisions.choice: So I will do to this temple what I did to Shiloh
decisions.reason: Readable states the main point first and gives the other parts in short sentences.

source.text: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלַ֨כְתִּי֙ אֶת־כָּל־אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־זֶ֥רַע אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will cast out you from on my face, as which I cast out all your brothers, all [the] offspring of Ephraim.

en.L: And I will cast you out from before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face, just as I cast out all your brothers, all the offspring of Ephraim.'
en.B: I will throw you out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence, just as I threw out all your kin, all the descendants of Ephraim.'
en.R: I will send you away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, just as I sent away your relatives, the people of Ephraim.'

es.L: Y {{plural_you:los|os}} echaré de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} rostro, así como eché a todos {{plural_you:sus hermanos|vuestros hermanos}}, a toda la descendencia de Efraín”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} arrojaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, así como arrojé a todos {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}}, a todos los descendientes de Efraín”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} alejaré de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, así como alejé a {{plural_you:sus parientes|vuestros parientes}}, el pueblo de Efraín”.

fr.L: Et je vous rejetterai de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face, comme j’ai rejeté tous vos frères, toute la descendance d’Éphraïm.”
fr.B: Je vous chasserai loin de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} présence, comme j’ai chassé tous vos frères, tous les descendants d’Éphraïm.”
fr.R: Je vous enverrai loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, comme j’ai envoyé loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} les gens de votre famille, le peuple d’Éphraïm.”

sw.L: Nami nitawatupa mbali na uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kama nilivyowatupa ndugu zenu wote, uzao wote wa Efraimu.'
sw.B: Nitawatupa mbali na uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kama vile nilivyowatupa ndugu zenu wote, wazao wote wa Efraimu.'
sw.R: Nitawafukuza mbali nami, kama vile nilivyowafukuza jamaa zenu, watu wa Efraimu.'

vi.L: Ta sẽ đuổi các ngươi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, y như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi tất cả anh em các ngươi, là cả dòng dõi Ép-ra-im.'
vi.B: Ta sẽ ném các ngươi ra khỏi sự hiện diện của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ném bỏ mọi người thân của các ngươi, là cả dòng dõi Ép-ra-im.'
vi.R: Ta sẽ đuổi các ngươi đi xa khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi bà con các ngươi là dân Ép-ra-im.'

decisions.choice: cast you out from before my face: send you into exile, away from the land where God is present
decisions.reason: God's face is his presence, which the people knew above all at the temple and in the land. To be cast out from it is to be driven from the land (2 Kings 24:20).

decisions.choice: your brothers, the offspring of Ephraim: the people of the northern kingdom of Israel
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the leading tribe of the north and its name stood for the whole northern kingdom. Assyria took Samaria and carried its people into exile in 722 BC, and Kings explains this as God casting them out of his sight (2 Kings 17:18-23). Judah would follow.

decisions.choice: the message Jeremiah is to proclaim ends here
decisions.reason: From verse 16 God speaks to Jeremiah alone (see verse 2).

decisions.choice: your kin (B); your relatives (R)
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow Israelites of the north, related to Judah as one family; Balanced and Readable use words that include the whole people.

decisions.choice: "vos frères" (L, B); "les gens de votre famille" (R)
decisions.reason: French "frères" readily means fellow members of a people, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says what is meant.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה אַל־תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל׀בְּעַד־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה וְאַל־תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛ם רִנָּ֥ה וּתְפִלָּ֖ה וְאַל־תִּפְגַּע־בִּ֑י כִּי־אֵינֶ֥נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, not pray for the people this, and not lift up for them cry and prayer, and not urge with me, for not I [am] hearing you.

en.L: And you, do not pray for this people, and do not lift up for them a cry or a prayer, and do not plead with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, for I am not listening to you.
en.B: As for you, do not pray for this people. Do not raise a cry or a prayer for them, and do not plead with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, because I will not listen to you.
en.R: Jeremiah, do not pray for these people. Do not cry out to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or pray for them. Do not beg {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to help them, because I will not listen to you.

es.L: Y tú, no ores por este pueblo, ni eleves por ellos clamor ni oración, ni {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} insistas, porque no te escucho.
es.B: En cuanto a ti, no ores por este pueblo. No eleves por ellos clamor ni oración, ni {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} supliques, porque no te escucharé.
es.R: Jeremías, no ores por esta gente. No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} clames ni ores por ellos. No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ruegues que los ayude, porque no te escucharé.

fr.L: Et toi, ne prie pas pour ce peuple, et n’élève pour eux ni cri ni prière, et n’insiste pas auprès de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, car je ne t’écoute pas.
fr.B: Quant à toi, ne prie pas pour ce peuple. N’élève pour eux ni supplication ni prière, et n’insiste pas auprès de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, car je ne t’écouterai pas.
fr.R: Jérémie, ne prie pas pour ce peuple. Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} supplie pas et ne prie pas pour eux. Ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demande pas de les aider, car je ne t’écouterai pas.

sw.B: Kwa upande wako, usiwaombee watu hawa. Usiinue kilio wala sala kwa ajili yao, wala usinisihi, kwa sababu sitakusikiliza.
sw.R: Yeremia, usiwaombee watu hawa. Usinililie wala kuwaombea. Usinisihi niwasaidie, kwa sababu sitakusikiliza.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, đừng cầu nguyện cho dân này, đừng vì chúng mà dâng lên tiếng kêu van hay lời cầu nguyện, và đừng nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không nghe ngươi đâu.
vi.B: Còn con, đừng cầu nguyện cho dân này. Đừng vì chúng mà kêu van hay cầu xin, và đừng nài nỉ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không nghe con đâu.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-rê-mi, đừng cầu nguyện cho dân này. Đừng kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hay cầu nguyện cho chúng. Đừng nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giúp chúng, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không nghe con đâu.

decisions.choice: do not pray for this people: the time for a prophet's plea has passed
decisions.reason: Prophets prayed for the people, as Moses did after the golden calf (Exodus 32:11-14) and as Samuel promised to do (1 Samuel 12:23). God forbids Jeremiah to do so because the people will not turn and his judgment is settled. The command returns in 11:14 and 14:11 (compare 15:1).

decisions.choice: cry, prayer, plead: every kind of appeal on their behalf
decisions.reason: "Cry" is a loud call for help, "prayer" a request to God, and "plead" means to press someone with a request, to intercede (27:18).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed, since God now turns from the people to the prophet.
