source.text: הַבָּנִ֞ים מְלַקְּטִ֣ים עֵצִ֗ים וְהָֽאָבוֹת֙ מְבַעֲרִ֣ים אֶת־הָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים לָשׁ֣וֹת בָּצֵ֑ק לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת כַּוָּנִ֜ים לִמְלֶ֣כֶת הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְהַסֵּ֤ךְ נְסָכִים֙ לֵאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: The children [are] gathering wood, and the fathers [are] kindling the fire, and the women [are] kneading dough to make cakes for [the] queen of the heavens, and pouring out drink offerings to gods other, so as to provoke me.

en.L: The {{gender:children|sons}} are gathering wood, and the fathers are kindling the fire, and the women are kneading dough to make cakes for the queen of heaven; and [they] pour out drink offerings to other gods, so as to provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: The {{gender:children|sons}} gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead dough to make cakes for the queen of heaven. They pour drink offerings out to other gods, and so they provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger.
en.R: The {{gender:children|sons}} gather wood. The fathers start the fire. The women mix dough and bake cakes for the goddess they call the queen of heaven. They pour out wine as offerings to other gods. In this way they make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry.

es.L: Los hijos recogen leña, y los padres encienden el fuego, y las mujeres amasan la masa para hacer tortas a la reina del cielo; y derraman libaciones a otros dioses, para provocar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo.
es.B: Los hijos recogen leña, los padres encienden el fuego y las mujeres amasan la masa para hacer tortas a la reina del cielo. Derraman libaciones a otros dioses, y así {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provocan a ira.
es.R: Los hijos recogen leña. Los padres encienden el fuego. Las mujeres preparan la masa y hornean tortas para la diosa a la que llaman la reina del cielo. Derraman vino como ofrenda a otros dioses. Así {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hacen enojar.

fr.L: Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ramassent du bois, et les pères allument le feu, et les femmes pétrissent la pâte pour faire des gâteaux à la reine du ciel ; et [ils] versent des libations à d’autres dieux, afin de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}offenser.
fr.B: Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ramassent le bois, les pères allument le feu, et les femmes pétrissent la pâte pour faire des gâteaux à la reine du ciel. Ils versent des libations à d’autres dieux, et ainsi ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}irritent.
fr.R: Les {{gender:enfants|fils}} ramassent du bois. Les pères allument le feu. Les femmes préparent la pâte et font cuire des gâteaux pour la déesse qu’on appelle la reine du ciel. Ils versent du vin en offrande à d’autres dieux. De cette façon, ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mettent en colère.

sw.L: Wana wanaokota kuni, na baba wanawasha moto, na wanawake wanakanda unga kuandaa mikate kwa ajili ya malkia wa mbinguni; na [wao] wanamwaga sadaka za kinywaji kwa miungu mingine, ili kunikasirisha.
sw.B: Watoto wanaokota kuni, baba wanawasha moto, na wanawake wanakanda unga kuoka mikate kwa ajili ya malkia wa mbinguni. Wanamimina sadaka za kinywaji kwa miungu mingine, na hivyo wananichokoza nikasirike.
sw.R: Watoto wanaokota kuni. Baba wanawasha moto. Wanawake wanakanda unga na kuoka mikate kwa ajili ya mungu wa kike wanayemwita malkia wa mbinguni. Wanamimina divai kama sadaka kwa miungu mingine. Kwa njia hii wananikasirisha.

vi.L: Con cái lượm củi, các người cha nhóm lửa, và đàn bà nhồi bột để làm bánh dâng cho nữ vương trên trời; và [chúng] đổ rượu dâng cho các thần khác, để chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Con cái lượm củi, cha nhóm lửa, đàn bà nhồi bột làm bánh dâng cho nữ vương trên trời. Chúng đổ rượu dâng cho các thần khác, và như thế chúng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Con cái lượm củi. Cha nhóm lửa. Đàn bà nhồi bột và nướng bánh dâng cho nữ thần mà chúng gọi là nữ vương trên trời. Chúng đổ rượu ra để dâng cho các thần khác. Bằng cách ấy chúng làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nổi giận.

decisions.choice: the queen of heaven: a goddess worshiped in Judah, probably a form of the Mesopotamian goddess Ishtar or the Canaanite Astarte
decisions.reason: The title fits a goddess linked with the sky and the morning and evening star. Her worship returns in 44:15-19, where the women of Judah, with their husbands' consent, say they made cakes, burned incense and poured out drink offerings to her, and that life went well while they did. Whole families share in it here: children, fathers and women.

decisions.choice: queen: the consonants of the Hebrew read naturally as "queen"
alternatives: the work of heaven (the host of the stars)
decisions.reason: The vowels added in the Hebrew text point the word as if it meant "the work of heaven", perhaps the stars, and some Hebrew copies spell it that way. The context requires a goddess: in 44:19 the women make cakes "to portray her". The reading "queen" is followed, as the Greek and other ancient translations also read it.

decisions.choice: cakes: special offering cakes, perhaps shaped like the goddess or stamped with her image
decisions.reason: The word is borrowed from the language of Mesopotamia and is used only here and in 44:19, where the cakes are made "to portray her".

decisions.choice: so as to provoke me: the result of what they do
decisions.reason: They do not mean to anger the LORD; they mean to please other gods. The result is that they provoke him. Verse 19 turns this around.

decisions.choice: the goddess they call the queen of heaven; wine
decisions.reason: Readable says who the queen of heaven was and what a drink offering was.

decisions.choice: "la reina del cielo" (L, B); "la diosa a la que llaman la reina del cielo" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it for Spanish; Readable says she was a goddess, as the English does. "Hijos" already includes daughters, so the English gender setting has no Spanish span.

decisions.choice: malkia wa mbinguni
decisions.reason: The goddess is named "malkia wa mbinguni" at every level, as the English keeps "the queen of heaven"; Readable adds "mungu wa kike" as the English Readable says "the goddess". The same name returns in chapter 44.

decisions.choice: "la reine du ciel" at every level; Readable adds "la déesse qu’on appelle"
decisions.reason: One wording for the goddess here and in chapter 44; "du ciel" is the ordinary French for a title in the sky.

decisions.choice: "nữ vương trên trời" (queen of heaven); Readable "nữ thần mà chúng gọi là nữ vương trên trời"
decisions.reason: A title, not a name, so it is lowercase; "trên trời" avoids "thiên đàng", which Christian readers hear as the place of the saved. Readable says she is a goddess, as the English Readable does. "Con cái" covers sons and daughters, so the English gender span is not needed.

source.text: הַאֹתִ֛י הֵ֥ם מַכְעִסִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֹתָ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן בֹּ֥שֶׁת פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Me they [are] provoking? declaration of Yahweh. [Is it] not themselves, for [the] shame of their faces?

en.L: Is it {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they are provoking? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Is it not themselves, to the shame of their own faces?
en.B: Is it really {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they are provoking? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Is it not themselves they hurt, to their own disgrace?
en.R: But am I the one they are hurting? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. No, they are only hurting themselves and bringing shame on themselves.

es.L: ¿Es a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a quien provocan?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. ¿No es a sí mismos, para vergüenza de sus propios rostros?
es.B: ¿De verdad es a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a quien provocan?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. ¿No se hacen daño a sí mismos, para su propia deshonra?
es.R: Pero ¿soy yo a quien están haciendo daño?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. No, solo se hacen daño a sí mismos y se cubren de vergüenza.

fr.L: Est-ce {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils offensent ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. N’est-ce pas eux-mêmes, pour la honte de leur visage ?
fr.B: Est-ce vraiment {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils irritent ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. N’est-ce pas à eux-mêmes qu’ils font du tort, pour leur propre honte ?
fr.R: Mais est-ce à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils font du mal ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Non, ils ne font du mal qu’à eux-mêmes et ils se couvrent de honte.

sw.L: Je, ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} wanayenikasirisha? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Je, si wao wenyewe, kwa aibu ya nyuso zao?
sw.B: Je, ni kweli {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} wanayenichokoza? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Je, si wao wenyewe wanaojidhuru, kwa aibu yao wenyewe?
sw.R: Lakini je, ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} wanayemdhuru? anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hapana, wanajidhuru wao wenyewe na kujiletea aibu.

vi.L: Có phải chúng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Chẳng phải chính chúng, để chuốc lấy sự hổ thẹn trên mặt mình sao?
vi.B: Có thật chúng chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Chẳng phải chúng tự làm hại chính mình, chuốc lấy sự nhục nhã cho mình sao?
vi.R: Nhưng có phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là người bị chúng làm tổn thương không? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Không, chúng chỉ làm hại chính mình và chuốc lấy sự hổ thẹn cho mình thôi.

decisions.choice: is it me they provoke? Is it not themselves?: they harm themselves more than God
decisions.reason: The verb means to provoke or vex. The second question uses the same verb without repeating it: is it not themselves they hurt? Their worship of other gods cannot injure God, but it will bring ruin on them.

decisions.choice: the shame of their faces: open disgrace
decisions.reason: Shame shows on the face. They will be publicly disgraced when the judgment comes.

decisions.choice: provoking ... hurt (B); hurting (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "hurt" where the verb is applied to the people themselves, since that is what provoking themselves means.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אַפִּ֤י וַֽחֲמָתִי֙ נִתֶּ֨כֶת֙ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַל־עֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְעַל־פְּרִ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: look, my anger and my wrath [is] being poured out on the place this, on the man and on the beast and on [the] tree of the field and on [the] fruit of the ground, and it will burn and not be quenched.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath are about to be poured out on this place, on {{gender:humans|man}} and on beast, and on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and not be quenched.
en.B: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury, is about to be poured out on this place, on people and animals, on the trees of the field and the crops of the ground. It will burn and not be put out.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I am about to pour out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great anger on this place. It will fall on people and animals, on the trees in the fields and on the crops in the ground. It will be like a fire that burns and cannot be put out.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Mira, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor se derramarán sobre este lugar, sobre los hombres y sobre los animales, y sobre los árboles del campo y sobre el fruto de la tierra; y arderá y no se apagará.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Mira, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, está a punto de derramarse sobre este lugar, sobre personas y animales, sobre los árboles del campo y los frutos de la tierra. Arderá y no se apagará.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Voy a derramar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran ira sobre este lugar. Caerá sobre la gente y los animales, sobre los árboles de los campos y sobre las cosechas de la tierra. Será como un fuego que arde y no se puede apagar.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur vont se répandre sur ce lieu, sur les {{gender:humains|hommes}} et sur les bêtes, et sur les arbres des champs et sur les fruits du sol ; elle brûlera et ne s’éteindra pas.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Voici, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, va se répandre sur ce lieu, sur les gens et sur les bêtes, sur les arbres des champs et sur les récoltes du sol. Elle brûlera et ne s’éteindra pas.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je vais déverser {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande colère sur ce lieu. Elle tombera sur les gens et sur les animaux, sur les arbres des champs et sur les récoltes. Elle sera comme un feu qui brûle et que personne ne peut éteindre.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itamwagwa juu ya mahali hapa, juu ya mwanadamu na juu ya mnyama, na juu ya miti ya shambani na juu ya matunda ya ardhi; nayo itawaka wala haitazimika.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Tazama, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, karibu itamwagwa juu ya mahali hapa, juu ya watu na wanyama, juu ya miti ya mashambani na mazao ya ardhi. Itawaka wala haitazimwa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Karibu nitamwaga hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kuu juu ya mahali hapa. Itawapata watu na wanyama, miti ya mashambani na mazao ya ardhi. Itakuwa kama moto unaowaka usioweza kuzimwa.

vi.L: Vì vậy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Kìa, cơn giận và cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp đổ xuống trên nơi này, trên người và trên thú vật, trên cây cối ngoài đồng và trên hoa quả của đất; nó sẽ cháy và không hề tắt.
vi.B: Vì thế Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Kìa, cơn giận, cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp đổ xuống trên nơi này, trên người và thú vật, trên cây cối ngoài đồng và hoa màu trên đất. Nó sẽ cháy mà không ai dập tắt được.
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta sắp đổ cơn giận lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} xuống nơi này. Cơn giận ấy sẽ giáng trên người và thú vật, trên cây cối ngoài đồng và hoa màu trên đất. Nó sẽ như ngọn lửa cháy mãi không ai dập tắt được.

decisions.choice: my anger and my wrath poured out ... it will burn and not be quenched: God's judgment pictured as fire
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as something poured out like liquid fire, and as a fire no one can put out (4:4; 21:12). It will fall on everything in the land: people, animals, trees and crops.

decisions.choice: is being poured out: about to happen
decisions.reason: The form describes something already under way or about to happen.

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "Lord" followed by God's name. Where the name follows "Lord" it is printed "GOD", to avoid "the Lord LORD" (as Isaiah 1:24).

decisions.choice: It will be like a fire
decisions.reason: Readable states the picture as a comparison.

source.text: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹלוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל־זִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם וְאִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: your burnt offerings add to your sacrifices, and eat meat.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat meat.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Go on, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat all the meat yourselves!

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: {{plural_you:Añadan sus holocaustos a sus sacrificios, y coman|Añadid vuestros holocaustos a vuestros sacrificios, y comed}} carne.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: ¡{{plural_you:Adelante, añadan sus holocaustos a sus sacrificios y cómanse|Adelante, añadid vuestros holocaustos a vuestros sacrificios y comeos}} la carne!
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: ¡{{plural_you:Sigan, añadan sus holocaustos a sus otros sacrificios y cómanse|Seguid, añadid vuestros holocaustos a vuestros otros sacrificios y comeos}} toda la carne!

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Ajoutez vos holocaustes à vos sacrifices, et mangez de la viande.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Allez-y, ajoutez vos holocaustes à vos sacrifices, et mangez-en la viande vous-mêmes !
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Allez-y, ajoutez vos holocaustes à vos autres sacrifices, et mangez toute la viande vous-mêmes !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: Ongezeni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa juu ya dhabihu zenu, mkale nyama.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Haya, ongezeni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa juu ya dhabihu zenu, mkale nyama wenyewe!
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Endeleeni tu, ongezeni sadaka zenu za kuteketezwa juu ya dhabihu zenu nyingine, mle nyama yote wenyewe!

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Hãy thêm các tế lễ thiêu vào các sinh tế của các ngươi, và ăn thịt đi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Cứ việc thêm các tế lễ thiêu vào các sinh tế của các ngươi, rồi tự ăn thịt đi!
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Cứ việc thêm các tế lễ thiêu vào các sinh tế khác của các ngươi, rồi tự ăn hết thịt đi!

decisions.choice: burnt offerings and sacrifices: offerings burned whole and offerings shared as a meal
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned entirely on the altar for God (Leviticus 1:9). In most other sacrifices the fat was burned and the worshipers ate the meat (Leviticus 7:15).

decisions.choice: add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat: a bitter command meaning that none of it matters to God
decisions.reason: God tells them to treat even the burnt offerings, which belonged wholly to him, as ordinary meat for their own meals. Since he does not accept their worship, they might as well eat it all.

decisions.choice: Go ahead; yourselves
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add words that make the irony plain.

source.text: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־דִבַּ֤רְתִּי אֶת־אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔ים בְּי֛וֹם הוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־דִּבְרֵ֥י עוֹלָ֖ה וָזָֽבַח׃

records.literal_gloss: For not I spoke with your fathers and not I commanded them in [the] day of my bringing out them from [the] land of Egypt concerning matters of burnt offering and sacrifice.

en.L: For I did not speak with your fathers, and I did not command them, in the day I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning matters of burnt offering and sacrifice.
en.B: For when I brought your ancestors out of the land of Egypt, I did not speak to them or give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices.
en.R: When I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I did not give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices.

es.L: Porque no hablé con {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} ni les mandé, el día que los saqué de la tierra de Egipto, acerca de asuntos de holocausto y sacrificio.
es.B: Porque cuando saqué a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de la tierra de Egipto, no les hablé ni les di mandatos acerca de holocaustos y sacrificios.
es.R: Cuando saqué a {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} de Egipto, no les di mandatos acerca de holocaustos y sacrificios.

fr.L: Car je n’ai pas parlé avec vos pères, et je ne leur ai pas donné d’ordres, le jour où je les ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, au sujet des holocaustes et des sacrifices.
fr.B: Car, lorsque j’ai fait sortir vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} du pays d’Égypte, je ne leur ai rien dit et je ne leur ai rien ordonné au sujet des holocaustes et des sacrifices.
fr.R: Quand j’ai fait sortir vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} d’Égypte, je ne leur ai pas donné d’ordres au sujet des holocaustes et des sacrifices.

sw.L: Kwa maana sikusema na baba zenu, wala sikuwaamuru, siku ile nilipowatoa katika nchi ya Misri, katika mambo ya sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu.
sw.B: Kwa maana nilipowatoa babu zenu katika nchi ya Misri, sikusema nao wala kuwapa amri kuhusu sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu.
sw.R: Nilipowatoa babu zenu Misri, sikuwapa amri kuhusu sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không phán với tổ phụ các ngươi, và đã không truyền cho họ, trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, về những việc tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế.
vi.B: Vì khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem tổ tiên các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không phán với họ hay truyền lệnh cho họ về tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế.
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem tổ tiên các ngươi ra khỏi Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không truyền lệnh cho họ về tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế.

decisions.choice: I did not command them concerning burnt offering and sacrifice: offerings were never the heart of what God asked; obedience was
alternatives: God never commanded sacrifice at all
the first commands, at the exodus itself, said nothing about offerings
I did not command offerings for my own sake
decisions.reason: The Law does command sacrifices (Leviticus 1-7), and Jeremiah knew it (17:26; 33:18). The point is a strong contrast, "not this but that", as in Hosea 6:6 and 1 Samuel 15:22: what God first and chiefly required was that the people listen to him (verse 23; Exodus 19:5). Sacrifices offered without obedience mean nothing to him. Some take the words more strictly: that the first words God spoke at the exodus, before the laws given at Sinai, were about obedience and not about offerings (Exodus 15:26).

decisions.choice: concerning matters of: about, on the subject of
decisions.reason: The phrase means "about" or "in the matter of". It could also mean "for the sake of", but "about" is its usual sense.

decisions.choice: when I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I did not speak to them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the time first and join the two verbs.

source.text: כִּ֣י אִֽם־אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹתָ֤ם לֵאמֹר֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ בְקוֹלִ֔י וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָכֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם בְּכָל־הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But only this word I commanded them, saying: Listen to my voice, and I will be to you for God, and you will be to me for a people; and you will walk in all the way which I command you, so that it may go well for you.

en.L: But this word I did command them, saying, 'Listen to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice, and I will be your God, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people; and walk in all the way that I command you, so that it may go well with you.'
en.B: Instead, this is what I commanded them: 'Obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} voice; then I will be your God, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. Walk in every way I command you, so that it may go well with you.'
en.R: This is what I did command them: 'Obey {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Then I will be your God, and you will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. Live the way I tell you to live, and things will go well for you.'

es.L: Sino que esta palabra sí les mandé, diciendo: “{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz, y yo seré {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo; y {{plural_you:anden|andad}} en todo el camino que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mande, para que {{plural_you:les|os}} vaya bien”.
es.B: Lo que sí les mandé fue esto: “{{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voz; entonces yo seré {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. {{plural_you:Anden|Andad}} en todo camino que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mande, para que {{plural_you:les|os}} vaya bien”.
es.R: Esto es lo que sí les mandé: “{{plural_you:Obedézcanme|Obedecedme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Entonces yo seré {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, y {{plural_you:ustedes serán|vosotros seréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} como yo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, y {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien”.

fr.L: Mais voici la parole que je leur ai ordonnée : “Écoutez {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix, et je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ; et marchez dans tout le chemin que je vous ordonne, afin que vous soyez heureux.”
fr.B: Voici plutôt ce que je leur ai ordonné : “Obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} voix ; alors je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Suivez tout le chemin que je vous prescris, afin que tout aille bien pour vous.”
fr.R: Voici ce que je leur ai vraiment ordonné : “Obéissez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Alors je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Vivez comme je vous dis de vivre, et tout ira bien pour vous.”

sw.L: Lakini neno hili niliwaamuru, nikisema, 'Isikilizeni sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nami nitakuwa Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; mkaende katika njia yote ninayowaamuru, ili mpate kufanikiwa.'
sw.B: Badala yake, hiki ndicho nilichowaamuru: 'Itiini sauti {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; ndipo nitakuwa Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Endeni katika kila njia ninayowaamuru, ili mambo yawaendee vizuri.'
sw.R: Hiki ndicho nilichowaamuru: 'Nitiini. Ndipo nitakuwa Mungu wenu, nanyi mtakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Ishini jinsi ninavyowaambia mwishi, na mambo yatawaendea vizuri.'

vi.L: Nhưng lời này {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ rằng: 'Hãy nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; hãy bước đi trong mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho các ngươi, để các ngươi được phước.'
vi.B: Nhưng điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ là: 'Hãy vâng theo tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy đi theo mọi đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho các ngươi, để các ngươi được phước.'
vi.R: Điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ là: 'Hãy vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Hãy sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bảo các ngươi, thì các ngươi sẽ được may mắn.'

decisions.choice: listen to my voice: obey me
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to do what they say (Exodus 19:5; Deuteronomy 13:5).

decisions.choice: I will be your God and you will be my people: the promise at the heart of the covenant
decisions.reason: These words sum up the covenant (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). Jeremiah returns to them in the promise of a new covenant (31:33).

decisions.choice: so that it may go well with you
decisions.reason: The same promise follows the call to obey in Deuteronomy 5:30 and 6:3.

decisions.choice: Live the way I tell you to live
decisions.reason: "Walk in the way" means to live one's life in a certain way; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "je serai votre Dieu, et vous serez mon peuple"
decisions.reason: The covenant promise keeps one wording at every level, the wording Jeremiah 31:33 and Hebrews 8:10 will use ("je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront mon peuple").

decisions.choice: "Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ là dân của Ta"
alternatives: "Ta sẽ làm Đức Chúa Trời các ngươi"
decisions.reason: The covenant formula is worded as the terms note fixes it for 31:33 (from Hebrews 8:10), so that it reads the same each time it returns in Jeremiah (11:4; 24:7; 30:22; 31:33; 32:38).

source.text: וְלֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְלֹֽא־הִטּ֣וּ אֶת־אָזְנָ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּמֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּשְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣ם הָרָ֑ע וַיִּהְי֥וּ לְאָח֖וֹר וְלֹ֥א לְפָנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they listened and not they inclined their ear, and they walked in counsels in [the] stubbornness of their heart the evil, and they were to backward and not to forward.

en.L: But they did not listen, and they did not incline their ear, and they walked in [their own] counsels, in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and they went backward and not forward.
en.B: But they did not listen or pay attention. They followed their own plans, in the stubbornness of their evil hearts. They went backward instead of forward.
en.R: But they would not listen or pay attention. They did what they wanted and stubbornly followed their own evil hearts. Instead of moving ahead, they went backward.

es.L: Pero no escucharon ni inclinaron su oído, sino que anduvieron en [sus propios] consejos, en la terquedad de su malvado corazón, y fueron hacia atrás y no hacia adelante.
es.B: Pero no escucharon ni prestaron atención. Siguieron sus propios planes, en la terquedad de su malvado corazón. Fueron hacia atrás en lugar de ir hacia adelante.
es.R: Pero no quisieron escuchar ni prestar atención. Hicieron lo que quisieron y siguieron con terquedad los malos deseos de su corazón. En lugar de avanzar, retrocedieron.

fr.L: Mais ils n’ont pas écouté et ils n’ont pas tendu l’oreille, et ils ont marché selon [leurs propres] conseils, dans l’obstination de leur cœur mauvais, et ils sont allés en arrière et non en avant.
fr.B: Mais ils n’ont pas écouté ni prêté attention. Ils ont suivi leurs propres projets, dans l’obstination de leur cœur mauvais. Ils ont reculé au lieu d’avancer.
fr.R: Mais ils n’ont pas voulu écouter ni faire attention. Ils ont fait ce qu’ils voulaient, et ils ont suivi avec obstination leur cœur mauvais. Au lieu d’avancer, ils ont reculé.

sw.L: Lakini hawakusikiliza, wala hawakutega sikio lao, bali walikwenda katika mashauri [yao wenyewe], katika ukaidi wa moyo wao mbaya, nao wakaenda nyuma wala si mbele.
sw.B: Lakini hawakusikiliza wala hawakujali. Walifuata mipango yao wenyewe, katika ukaidi wa mioyo yao miovu. Walikwenda nyuma badala ya kwenda mbele.
sw.R: Lakini hawakutaka kusikiliza wala kujali. Walifanya walivyotaka na kufuata kwa ukaidi mioyo yao miovu. Badala ya kusonga mbele, walirudi nyuma.

vi.L: Nhưng chúng đã không nghe, cũng không nghiêng tai, mà bước theo [những] mưu kế [riêng], theo sự cứng cỏi của lòng gian ác mình, và chúng đã đi thụt lùi chứ không tiến tới.
vi.B: Nhưng chúng đã không nghe cũng không để ý. Chúng đi theo mưu kế riêng, theo sự cứng cỏi của lòng gian ác mình. Chúng đã đi lùi thay vì tiến tới.
vi.R: Nhưng chúng không chịu nghe hay để ý. Chúng làm theo ý mình và cứng đầu làm theo lòng gian ác của mình. Thay vì tiến tới, chúng lại đi thụt lùi.

decisions.choice: incline their ear: pay attention
decisions.reason: To bend the ear toward someone is to listen closely and take in what they say.

decisions.choice: in their own plans, in the stubbornness of their evil heart: following their own will
decisions.reason: The "counsels" are their own plans and ideas. "Stubbornness of heart" is a hard, fixed self-will (Deuteronomy 29:18; Jeremiah 3:17; 9:13). The heart is the seat of thought and will, not only of feeling.

decisions.choice: they went backward and not forward: instead of moving on with God they turned away
decisions.reason: Their history was a retreat, not progress.

decisions.choice: the stubbornness of their evil heart (L); the stubbornness of their evil hearts (B); stubbornly followed their own evil hearts (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this phrase throughout Jeremiah.

source.text: לְמִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־כָּל־עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים י֖וֹם הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְשָׁלֹֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And from the day that came out your fathers from [the] land of Egypt until the day this, and I sent to you all my servants the prophets, day rising early and sending.

en.L: From the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent to you all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets, day after day, rising early and sending [them].
en.B: From the day your ancestors left the land of Egypt until today, I have sent you all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets, day after day, again and again.
en.R: From the day your ancestors left Egypt until now, I have sent {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants the prophets to you. I sent them day after day, over and over.

es.L: Desde el día en que {{plural_you:sus padres|vuestros padres}} salieron de la tierra de Egipto hasta este día, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enviado a todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas, cada día, madrugando y enviando[los].
es.B: Desde el día en que {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} salieron de la tierra de Egipto hasta hoy, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enviado a todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas, día tras día, una y otra vez.
es.R: Desde el día en que {{plural_you:sus antepasados|vuestros antepasados}} salieron de Egipto hasta ahora, {{plural_you:les|os}} he enviado a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos los profetas. Los envié día tras día, una y otra vez.

fr.L: Depuis le jour où vos pères sont sortis du pays d’Égypte jusqu’à ce jour, je vous ai envoyé tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes, chaque jour, me levant de bonne heure et [les] envoyant.
fr.B: Depuis le jour où vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} ont quitté le pays d’Égypte jusqu’à aujourd’hui, je vous ai envoyé tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes, jour après jour, sans relâche.
fr.R: Depuis le jour où vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} ont quitté l’Égypte jusqu’à maintenant, je vous ai envoyé {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} serviteurs les prophètes. Je les ai envoyés jour après jour, encore et encore.

sw.L: Tangu siku ile baba zenu walipotoka katika nchi ya Misri hata siku hii ya leo, nimewatumia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wote manabii, siku kwa siku, nikiamka mapema na kuwatuma.
sw.B: Tangu siku babu zenu walipotoka katika nchi ya Misri mpaka leo, nimewatumia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wote manabii, siku baada ya siku, tena na tena.
sw.R: Tangu siku babu zenu walipotoka Misri mpaka sasa, nimewatumia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} manabii. Niliwatuma siku baada ya siku, mara nyingi sana.

vi.L: Từ ngày tổ phụ các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập cho đến ngày nay, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến với các ngươi tất cả các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri, ngày qua ngày, dậy sớm mà sai [họ] đi.
vi.B: Từ ngày tổ tiên các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập cho đến hôm nay, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai đến với các ngươi tất cả các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri, ngày này qua ngày khác, hết lần này đến lần khác.
vi.R: Từ ngày tổ tiên các ngươi rời Ai Cập cho đến nay, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã sai các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là các nhà tiên tri đến với các ngươi. Ta đã sai họ đến ngày này qua ngày khác, nhiều lần.

decisions.choice: day after day, rising early and sending: sending prophets constantly, without giving up
decisions.reason: As in verse 13. "Day" stands before the phrase: God sent them daily. Kings says the same of the warnings sent through the prophets (2 Kings 17:13).

decisions.choice: my servants the prophets: those who served God by bringing his word
decisions.reason: The word for servant marks someone who belongs to a master and acts for him. Applied to the prophets it is a title of honor: they spoke for God (2 Kings 9:7; Amos 3:7).

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, "servant" is kept at every level when the word names those who serve God.

decisions.choice: rising early and sending (L); again and again (B); over and over (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 13.

decisions.choice: "mis siervos los profetas"
decisions.reason: Siervo at every level, as the terms note sets it for Spanish; "rising early and sending" follows the wording of verse 13.

decisions.choice: "serviteurs" at Literal too
decisions.reason: God's servants the prophets are named servants, so French says "serviteurs" at every level, as Kings does for God's named servants.

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ Ta là các nhà tiên tri"
decisions.reason: The terms note: God's servants are "đầy tớ" at every level, Literal included, and never "nô lệ".

source.text: וְל֤וֹא שָׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־אָזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עָרְפָּ֔ם הֵרֵ֖עוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they listened to me and not they inclined their ear, and they stiffened their neck; they did evil more than their fathers.

en.L: But they did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or incline their ear; they stiffened their neck; they did more evil than their fathers.
en.B: Yet they did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or pay attention. They stiffened their necks and did more evil than their ancestors.
en.R: But they did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} or pay attention. They were stubborn and refused to obey. They did even more evil things than their ancestors.

es.L: Pero no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharon ni inclinaron su oído; endurecieron su cerviz; hicieron más mal que sus padres.
es.B: Pero no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharon ni prestaron atención. Se pusieron tercos e hicieron más mal que sus antepasados.
es.R: Pero no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} escucharon ni prestaron atención. Fueron tercos y se negaron a obedecer. Hicieron cosas aún peores que sus antepasados.

fr.L: Mais ils ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont pas écouté et n’ont pas tendu l’oreille ; ils ont raidi leur nuque ; ils ont fait pire que leurs pères.
fr.B: Pourtant ils ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont pas écouté ni prêté attention. Ils ont raidi la nuque et ont fait pire que leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.
fr.R: Mais ils ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont pas écouté et n’ont pas fait attention. Ils ont été têtus et ils ont refusé d’obéir. Ils ont fait encore plus de mal que leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}.

sw.L: Lakini hawakunisikiliza wala hawakutega sikio lao; walifanya shingo yao kuwa ngumu; walifanya mabaya kuliko baba zao.
sw.B: Hata hivyo hawakunisikiliza wala hawakujali. Walishupaza shingo zao na kutenda mabaya kuliko babu zao.
sw.R: Lakini hawakunisikiliza wala hawakujali. Walikuwa wakaidi na wakakataa kutii. Walitenda mabaya kuliko hata babu zao.

vi.L: Nhưng chúng đã không nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng không nghiêng tai; chúng đã cứng cổ; chúng đã làm điều ác hơn tổ phụ mình.
vi.B: Thế mà chúng vẫn không nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hay để ý. Chúng cứng cổ và làm điều ác còn hơn tổ tiên mình.
vi.R: Nhưng chúng không nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hay để ý. Chúng cứng đầu và không chịu vâng lời. Chúng còn làm nhiều điều ác hơn tổ tiên mình.

decisions.choice: they stiffened their neck: they refused to submit
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox that will not bend its neck to the yoke (Exodus 32:9; Deuteronomy 10:16; Jeremiah 17:23).

decisions.choice: they did more evil than their fathers: each generation went further than the one before
decisions.reason: "They" are the generations since the exodus, down to Jeremiah's hearers, each worse than the last (16:12).

decisions.choice: They were stubborn and refused to obey
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture.

source.text: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵיהֶם֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֽוּכָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will speak to them all the words these, and not they will listen to you; and you will call to them, and not they will answer you.

en.L: And you will speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you; and you will call to them, but they will not answer you.
en.B: When you speak all these words to them, they will not listen to you; when you call them, they will give you no answer.
en.R: Jeremiah, you will tell them all these things, but they will not listen to you. You will call to them, but they will not answer.

es.L: Y tú les hablarás todas estas palabras, pero no te escucharán; y los llamarás, pero no te responderán.
es.B: Cuando les digas todas estas palabras, no te escucharán; cuando los llames, no te responderán.
es.R: Jeremías, tú les dirás todas estas cosas, pero no te escucharán. Los llamarás, pero no te responderán.

fr.L: Et tu leur diras toutes ces paroles, mais ils ne t’écouteront pas ; et tu les appelleras, mais ils ne te répondront pas.
fr.B: Quand tu leur diras toutes ces paroles, ils ne t’écouteront pas ; quand tu les appelleras, ils ne te répondront pas.
fr.R: Jérémie, tu leur diras toutes ces choses, mais ils ne t’écouteront pas. Tu les appelleras, mais ils ne répondront pas.

sw.L: Nawe utawaambia maneno haya yote, lakini hawatakusikiliza; nawe utawaita, lakini hawatakuitikia.
sw.B: Utakapowaambia maneno haya yote, hawatakusikiliza; utakapowaita, hawatakujibu.
sw.R: Yeremia, utawaambia mambo haya yote, lakini hawatakusikiliza. Utawaita, lakini hawatakuitikia.

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ nói với chúng tất cả những lời này, nhưng chúng sẽ không nghe ngươi; ngươi sẽ gọi chúng, nhưng chúng sẽ không trả lời ngươi.
vi.B: Khi con nói với chúng tất cả những lời này, chúng sẽ không nghe con; khi con gọi chúng, chúng sẽ chẳng trả lời con.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-rê-mi, con sẽ nói với chúng tất cả những điều này, nhưng chúng sẽ không nghe con. Con sẽ gọi chúng, nhưng chúng sẽ không trả lời.

decisions.choice: they will not listen to you: the prophet will meet the same refusal God has met
decisions.reason: God warns Jeremiah ahead of time. The people's answer to him will be what it was to God in verse 13: no listening and no answer.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, Readable names the one addressed.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם זֶ֤ה הַגּוֹי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֽוֹא־שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּקוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א לָקְח֖וּ מוּסָ֑ר אָֽבְדָה֙ הָֽאֱמוּנָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מִפִּיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you will say to them: This [is] the nation which not listened to [the] voice of Yahweh its God, and not received correction; has perished the faithfulness, and it is cut off from their mouth.

en.L: And you will say to them, 'This [is] the nation that did not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} its God and did not accept correction. Faithfulness has perished; it is cut off from their mouth.'
en.B: Then say to them, 'This is the nation that has not obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} its God and would not accept correction. Faithfulness has died; it is gone from their lips.'
en.R: So say to them, 'This nation has not obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} its God. It would not learn when it was corrected. Faithfulness is gone. It has vanished from their mouths.'

es.L: Y les dirás: “Esta [es] la nación que no escuchó la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios ni aceptó corrección. Ha perecido la fidelidad; ha sido cortada de su boca”.
es.B: Entonces diles: “Esta es la nación que no ha obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios ni quiso aceptar la corrección. La fidelidad ha muerto; ha desaparecido de sus labios”.
es.R: Así que diles: “Esta nación no ha obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} su Dios. No quiso aprender cuando fue corregida. La fidelidad se acabó. Ha desaparecido de su boca”.

fr.L: Et tu leur diras : “C’[est] ici la nation qui n’a pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu et qui n’a pas accepté la correction. La fidélité a péri ; elle est retranchée de leur bouche.”
fr.B: Alors dis-leur : “Voici la nation qui n’a pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} son Dieu et qui n’a pas voulu accepter la leçon. La fidélité est morte ; elle a disparu de leurs lèvres.”
fr.R: Alors dis-leur : “Cette nation n’a pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} son Dieu. Elle n’a pas voulu apprendre quand on la corrigeait. La fidélité a disparu. On ne la trouve plus dans leur bouche.”

sw.L: Nawe utawaambia, 'Hili [ndilo] taifa ambalo halikuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake, wala halikupokea marudi. Uaminifu umepotea; umekatiliwa mbali na kinywa chao.'
sw.B: Kisha uwaambie, 'Hili ndilo taifa ambalo halikumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake wala halikukubali kurudiwa. Uaminifu umekufa; umetoweka midomoni mwao.'
sw.R: Kwa hiyo uwaambie, 'Taifa hili halikumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. Halikutaka kujifunza lilipokaripiwa. Uaminifu umetoweka. Umepotea vinywani mwao.'

vi.L: Ngươi sẽ nói với chúng: 'Đây [là] dân tộc đã không nghe tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của mình, và không nhận sự sửa phạt. Sự thành tín đã tiêu mất; nó đã bị cắt khỏi miệng chúng.'
vi.B: Rồi hãy nói với chúng: 'Đây là dân tộc đã không vâng theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của mình và không chịu nhận sự sửa phạt. Sự thành tín đã chết; nó đã biến khỏi môi miệng chúng.'
vi.R: Vậy hãy nói với chúng: 'Dân tộc này đã không vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của mình. Nó không chịu học khi bị sửa phạt. Sự thành tín đã không còn. Nó đã biến mất khỏi miệng chúng.'

decisions.choice: faithfulness: being reliable and true, in speech as in action
decisions.reason: The word means firmness, the quality of someone who can be relied on. Because it is "cut off from their mouth", truthful speech is especially in view (9:2-4).

decisions.choice: correction: discipline meant to teach
decisions.reason: The word means instruction or training, often through punishment. God had disciplined the people, but they did not learn from it (2:30; 5:3).

decisions.choice: this is the nation: a verdict on the whole people
decisions.reason: Jeremiah is to pronounce it to them as God's judgment on them.

decisions.choice: This nation has not obeyed ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the verdict a plain statement.

source.text: גָּזִּ֤י נִזְרֵךְ֙ וְֽהַשְׁלִ֔יכִי וּשְׂאִ֥י עַל־שְׁפָיִ֖ם קִינָ֑ה כִּ֚י מָאַ֣ס יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּטֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־דּ֥וֹר עֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Shear your consecrated [hair] and throw [it] away, and lift up on bare heights a lament, for has rejected Yahweh and abandoned [the] generation of his wrath.

en.L: Cut off your consecrated hair and throw [it] away, and raise a lament on the bare heights, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has rejected and forsaken the generation of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath.
en.B: Cut off your consecrated hair and throw it away; raise a lament on the bare hills, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has rejected and abandoned the generation that is under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath.
en.R: Jerusalem, cut off the hair that marks you as God's and throw it away. Go up to the bare hilltops and sing a song of mourning. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has rejected and abandoned this generation, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry with them.

es.L: Córtate el cabello consagrado y arrója[lo], y eleva un lamento sobre las alturas desnudas, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha rechazado y abandonado a la generación de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: Córtate el cabello consagrado y tíralo; eleva un lamento sobre las colinas peladas, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha rechazado y abandonado a la generación que está bajo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.R: Jerusalén, córtate el cabello que muestra que perteneces a Dios y tíralo. Sube a las colinas peladas y canta un canto de luto. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha rechazado y abandonado a esta generación, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está enojado con ella.

fr.L: Coupe ta chevelure consacrée et jette-[la], et élève une lamentation sur les hauteurs dénudées, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rejeté et abandonné la génération de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur.
fr.B: Coupe ta chevelure consacrée et jette-la ; entonne une lamentation sur les collines dénudées, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rejeté et abandonné la génération qui a provoqué {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} fureur.
fr.R: Jérusalem, coupe tes cheveux, signe que tu appartiens à Dieu, et jette-les. Monte sur les collines dénudées et chante un chant de deuil. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rejeté et abandonné cette génération, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en colère contre elle.

sw.L: Kata nywele zako za wakfu uzitupe, upaze maombolezo juu ya vilele vilivyo wazi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekikataa na kukiacha kizazi cha ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Kata nywele zako za wakfu uzitupe; paza maombolezo juu ya vilima vilivyo wazi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekikataa na kukiacha kizazi kilicho chini ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Ee Yerusalemu, kata nywele zinazoonyesha kwamba wewe ni mali ya Mungu uzitupe. Panda juu ya vilele vya vilima vilivyo wazi uimbe wimbo wa maombolezo. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amekikataa na kukiacha kizazi hiki, kwa sababu amewakasirikia.

vi.L: Hãy cắt tóc đã biệt riêng của ngươi mà ném [đi], và cất tiếng ai ca trên các đồi trọc, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khước từ và lìa bỏ dòng dõi đã chọc cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy cắt bỏ tóc đã biệt riêng của ngươi mà ném đi; hãy cất tiếng ai ca trên các đồi trọc, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khước từ và lìa bỏ thế hệ đang chịu cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, hãy cắt tóc là dấu cho thấy ngươi thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời, và ném đi. Hãy lên các đỉnh đồi trọc và hát bài ca tang chế. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã khước từ và lìa bỏ thế hệ này, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giận chúng.

decisions.choice: the commands are addressed to a woman: Jerusalem, pictured as a woman in mourning
decisions.reason: The verbs are feminine singular. As often in Jeremiah, the city is addressed as a woman (4:30-31; 6:26).

decisions.choice: cut off your consecrated hair: shave the head as a sign of grief
decisions.reason: The word for hair here is used for the uncut hair of a Nazirite, the sign of being set apart to God (Numbers 6:5, 18-19); it can also mean a crown. Cutting the hair was a sign of mourning (16:6; Micah 1:16). Jerusalem is to throw away the mark of her belonging to God, because he has rejected her.

decisions.choice: a lament on the bare heights: a mourning song on the open hilltops
decisions.reason: A lament was the formal song of grief sung for the dead. The bare heights were places where Israel had worshiped other gods (3:2, 21); now they are where she must mourn.

decisions.choice: the generation of his wrath: the generation that has come under God's anger
decisions.reason: Their own deeds have brought God's wrath on them, and they will feel it.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem; the hair that marks you as God's
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed (see m1) and says what the hair meant.

decisions.choice: kata ... uzitupe (singular)
decisions.reason: The commands are to Jerusalem as one woman (meaning decision m1); Swahili shows the singular in the verbs and "zako", though it cannot show the feminine.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" (Literal) / "con" (Balanced, Readable) for Jerusalem addressed as a woman
decisions.reason: The commands are feminine singular, addressed to Jerusalem (meaning decision m1); Vietnamese uses God's address to one person, as for Zion elsewhere.

source.text: כִּֽי־עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָ֥ה הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינַ֖י נְאֻום־יְהוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵיהֶ֗ם בַּבַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא־שְׁמִ֥י עָלָ֖יו לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For have done [the] sons of Judah the evil in my eyes, declaration of Yahweh; they have set their detestable things in the house which is called my name on it, to defile it.

en.L: For the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah have done what is evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They have set their detestable things in the house that is called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, to defile it.
en.B: The {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done what is evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They have placed their detestable idols in the house that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name and so defiled it.
en.R: The {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah have done what I say is evil, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They have put their disgusting idols in the temple that bears {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and so they have made it unclean.

es.L: Porque los hijos de Judá han hecho lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Han puesto sus abominaciones en la casa que es llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, para contaminarla.
es.B: La gente de Judá ha hecho lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Ha puesto sus ídolos abominables en la casa que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y así la ha contaminado.
es.R: La gente de Judá ha hecho lo que yo digo que es malo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Ha puesto sus ídolos repugnantes en el templo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y así lo ha hecho impuro.

fr.L: Car les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda ont fait ce qui est mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont placé leurs abominations dans la maison sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom est invoqué, pour la souiller.
fr.B: Les {{gender:habitants|fils}} de Juda ont fait ce qui est mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont installé leurs idoles abominables dans la maison qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et ils l’ont ainsi souillée.
fr.R: Les {{gender:habitants|fils}} de Juda ont fait ce que je trouve mal, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils ont mis leurs idoles dégoûtantes dans le temple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et ils l’ont rendu impur.

sw.L: Kwa maana wana wa Yuda wametenda yaliyo mabaya machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wameweka machukizo yao katika nyumba iitwayo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, ili kuitia unajisi.
sw.B: Watu wa Yuda wametenda yaliyo mabaya machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wameweka sanamu zao za kuchukiza katika nyumba inayoitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, na hivyo wameitia unajisi.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda wametenda yale ninayoyaita maovu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wameweka sanamu zao za kuchukiza katika hekalu linaloitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, na hivyo wamelifanya najisi.

vi.L: Vì con cái Giu-đa đã làm điều ác trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Chúng đã đặt các vật ghê tởm của chúng trong nhà được gọi bằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, để làm ô uế nhà ấy.
vi.B: Con dân Giu-đa đã làm điều ác trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Chúng đã đặt các thần tượng ghê tởm của chúng trong nhà mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và làm ô uế nhà ấy.
vi.R: Dân Giu-đa đã làm những điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho là ác, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Chúng đã đặt các thần tượng ghê tởm của chúng trong đền thờ mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và như thế chúng đã làm cho đền thờ ra ô uế.

decisions.choice: their detestable things: idols and objects of worship of other gods
decisions.reason: The word is a strong term of disgust for idols (2 Kings 23:13). Manasseh had set up altars and an Asherah pole in the temple itself (2 Kings 21:4-7), and Josiah had cleared them out (2 Kings 23:4-6); here they have returned.

decisions.choice: to defile it: with the result that the temple became unclean
decisions.reason: The words may state their aim or, more likely, the result: by bringing idols into God's house they made it unclean.

decisions.choice: the evil in my eyes: what God judges to be evil
decisions.reason: The phrase is common in Kings for the sins of the kings (2 Kings 21:2).

decisions.choice: idols
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the detestable things were.

source.text: וּבָנ֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת הַתֹּ֗פֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם לִשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צִוִּ֔יתִי וְלֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל־לִבִּֽי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they have built [the] high places of the Topheth which [is] in [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which not I commanded and not it came up on my heart.

en.L: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which [is] in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I did not command, and [which] did not come up into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart.
en.B: In the Valley of Ben-hinnom they have built the high places of Topheth, to burn their sons and daughters in the fire, a thing I never commanded and that never entered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mind.
en.R: They have built shrines at Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. There they burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices. I never commanded them to do that. I never even thought of such a thing.

es.L: Y han edificado los lugares altos del Tofet, que [está] en el valle de Ben-hinom, para quemar a sus hijos y a sus hijas en el fuego, cosa que yo no mandé, ni subió a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón.
es.B: En el valle de Ben-hinom han edificado los lugares altos del Tofet, para quemar a sus hijos y a sus hijas en el fuego, algo que yo nunca mandé y que nunca pasó por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mente.
es.R: Han edificado santuarios en el Tofet, en el valle de Ben-hinom. Allí queman a sus hijos y a sus hijas en el fuego como sacrificios. Yo nunca les mandé hacer eso. Ni siquiera pensé jamás en algo así.

fr.L: Et ils ont bâti les hauts lieux du Topheth, qui [est] dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pour brûler au feu leurs fils et leurs filles, ce que je n’ai pas ordonné et qui n’est pas monté à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur.
fr.B: Dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, ils ont bâti les hauts lieux du Topheth, pour brûler au feu leurs fils et leurs filles, chose que je n’ai jamais ordonnée et qui ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est jamais venue à l’esprit.
fr.R: Ils ont construit des sanctuaires au Topheth, dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom. Là, ils brûlent leurs fils et leurs filles dans le feu en sacrifice. Je ne leur ai jamais ordonné de faire cela. Je n’y ai même jamais pensé.

sw.L: Nao wamejenga mahali pa juu pa Tofethi, palipo katika bonde la Ben-hinomu, ili kuwateketeza wana wao na binti zao kwa moto, jambo ambalo sikuliamuru, wala halikuingia moyoni {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.B: Katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu wamejenga mahali pa juu pa Tofethi, ili kuwateketeza wana wao na binti zao kwa moto, jambo ambalo sikuwahi kuliamuru wala halikuwahi kuingia akilini {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.R: Wamejenga madhabahu za miungu huko Tofethi katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu. Huko wanawateketeza wana wao na binti zao motoni kama dhabihu. Sikuwahi kuwaamuru wafanye hivyo. Wala sikuwahi hata kuwaza jambo kama hilo.

vi.L: Chúng đã xây các nơi cao Tô-phết, ở trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để thiêu con trai và con gái mình trong lửa, là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không truyền, và [điều] đã không hề đến trong lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Chúng đã xây các nơi cao Tô-phết trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để thiêu con trai và con gái mình trong lửa, là điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề truyền và cũng chưa hề nghĩ đến.
vi.R: Chúng đã xây các miếu thờ tại Tô-phết trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm. Tại đó chúng thiêu con trai và con gái mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế. Ta chưa bao giờ truyền cho chúng làm điều ấy. Ta chưa bao giờ nghĩ đến một điều như thế.

decisions.choice: Topheth, in the Valley of Ben-hinnom: the place of child sacrifice that Josiah had defiled (2 Kings 23:10)
decisions.reason: The place and valley are named as in 2 Kings 23:10. Topheth was the place of burning in the valley south of Jerusalem. Josiah had defiled it to stop the practice, but after his death it returned. 2 Kings speaks of making children "pass through the fire"; Jeremiah says plainly that they burned them (19:5).

decisions.choice: to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire: child sacrifice
decisions.reason: The Law forbade it as something God hates (Deuteronomy 12:31; 18:10). Ahaz and Manasseh had done it (2 Kings 16:3; 21:6).

decisions.choice: high places: raised places of worship, here built in the valley
decisions.reason: The word usually means hilltop shrines. Here it names raised platforms or altars built in the valley at Topheth.

decisions.choice: nor did it come up into my heart: God never thought of such a thing
decisions.reason: The heart is the place of thought and purpose. God never commanded this, nor did he ever intend it (19:5; 32:35).

decisions.choice: shrines
decisions.reason: Readable says "shrines"; "hilltop shrines", used for this word in Kings, would not fit a valley.

decisions.choice: as sacrifices
decisions.reason: Readable says why the children were burned.

decisions.choice: "el Tofet, en el valle de Ben-hinom"; "los lugares altos" (L, B); "santuarios" (R)
decisions.reason: The names as published in 2 Kings 23:10 and set by the terms note; high places as the Kings and Chronicles note sets them, with Readable's plainer word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Tofethi, bonde la Ben-hinomu
decisions.reason: The place names as the published 2 Kings 23:10.

decisions.choice: "le Topheth", "la vallée de Ben-Hinnom"; "des sanctuaires" (R)
decisions.reason: The forms of 2 Kings 23:10; as the English, Readable does not use the Kings wording for high places ("sanctuaires sur les collines"), which would not fit a valley.

decisions.choice: "Tô-phết", "thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm"
decisions.reason: The published forms of 2 Kings 23:10, kept through Jeremiah (19:2-14; 32:35).

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה־יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַתֹּ֨פֶת֙ וְגֵ֣יא בֶן־הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם־גֵּ֣יא הַהֲרֵגָ֑ה וְקָבְר֥וּ בְתֹ֖פֶת מֵאֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore look, days [are] coming, declaration of Yahweh, and not it will be called again the Topheth and [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, but [the] valley of the slaughter; and they will bury in Topheth from there is no room.

en.L: Therefore look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter; and they will bury in Topheth because there is no room.
en.B: So look, the days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when it will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the dead in Topheth because there will be no room anywhere else.
en.R: So the time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom. They will call it the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the dead in Topheth because there will be no room left anywhere else.

es.L: Por tanto, he aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que no se llamará más el Tofet ni valle de Ben-hinom, sino valle de la Matanza; y enterrarán en el Tofet por no haber lugar.
es.B: Por eso vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que ya no se llamará el Tofet ni valle de Ben-hinom, sino valle de la Matanza. Enterrarán a los muertos en el Tofet porque no habrá lugar en ninguna otra parte.
es.R: Por eso se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que la gente ya no llamará a este lugar el Tofet ni valle de Ben-hinom. Lo llamarán valle de la Matanza. Enterrarán a los muertos en el Tofet porque no quedará lugar en ninguna otra parte.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où on ne dira plus le Topheth ni la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, mais la vallée du Carnage ; et on enterrera au Topheth faute de place.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où on ne l’appellera plus le Topheth ni la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, mais la vallée du Carnage. On enterrera les morts au Topheth, faute de place ailleurs.
fr.R: Alors un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où on n’appellera plus cet endroit le Topheth ni la vallée de Ben-Hinnom. On l’appellera la vallée du Carnage. On enterrera les morts au Topheth, parce qu’il n’y aura plus de place ailleurs.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo hapataitwa tena Tofethi wala bonde la Ben-hinomu, bali bonde la Machinjo; nao watazika katika Tofethi kwa sababu hakuna nafasi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo mahali hapo hapataitwa tena Tofethi wala Bonde la Ben-hinomu, bali Bonde la Machinjo. Watawazika wafu katika Tofethi kwa sababu hakutakuwa na nafasi mahali pengine.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo watu hawataita tena mahali hapa Tofethi wala Bonde la Ben-hinomu. Watapaita Bonde la Machinjo. Watawazika wafu katika Tofethi kwa sababu hakutabaki nafasi mahali pengine popote.

vi.L: Vì vậy kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi người ta sẽ không còn gọi nó là Tô-phết hay thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, nhưng là thung lũng Tàn Sát; và người ta sẽ chôn trong Tô-phết vì không còn chỗ.
vi.B: Vì thế kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi người ta sẽ không còn gọi nơi này là Tô-phết hay thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm nữa, nhưng là thung lũng Tàn Sát. Người ta sẽ chôn xác chết tại Tô-phết vì không còn chỗ nào khác.
vi.R: Vì vậy, thời kỳ đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, khi người ta sẽ không còn gọi nơi này là Tô-phết hay thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm nữa. Họ sẽ gọi nó là thung lũng Tàn Sát. Họ sẽ chôn người chết tại Tô-phết vì không còn chỗ nào khác.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Slaughter: the place where they killed their children will be filled with their own dead
decisions.reason: The valley will get a new name from what happens there when the city falls. The place of their sin becomes the place of their judgment (19:6, 11).

decisions.choice: because there is no room: for lack of space elsewhere
alternatives: until there is no room left
decisions.reason: The words mean literally "from there being no place". They are taken to mean that the dead will be buried even in the unclean ground of Topheth because there is no room anywhere else, as 19:11 says. They could also mean that burials will go on there until no room is left.

decisions.choice: days are coming: a time is coming
decisions.reason: A phrase Jeremiah often uses to announce what God will do in the future (9:24; 16:14; 31:31).

decisions.choice: the time is coming
decisions.reason: Readable says "time" for "days".

decisions.choice: "he aquí que vienen días" (L); "vienen días" (B); "viene un tiempo" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula "days are coming" at each level, as the terms note sets it for Spanish, wherever it returns in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "Voici, des jours viennent" (L); "Des jours viennent" (B); "Un temps vient" (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: One wording per level for this recurring phrase, as for 31:31.

source.text: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה נִבְלַ֨ת הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be [the] corpse of the people this for food for [the] birds of the heavens and for [the] beasts of the earth, and there is none frightening [them].

en.L: And the corpses of this people will be food for the birds of the heavens and for the beasts of the earth, and none will frighten [them away].
en.B: The dead bodies of this people will become food for the birds of the sky and for the wild animals, and no one will scare them off.
en.R: The birds and the wild animals will eat the dead bodies of these people, and no one will be left to chase them away.

es.L: Y los cadáveres de este pueblo serán comida para las aves del cielo y para las bestias de la tierra, y no habrá quien [las] espante.
es.B: Los cadáveres de este pueblo serán comida para las aves del cielo y para los animales salvajes, y nadie los espantará.
es.R: Las aves y los animales salvajes se comerán los cadáveres de esta gente, y no quedará nadie para espantarlos.

fr.L: Et les cadavres de ce peuple serviront de nourriture aux oiseaux du ciel et aux bêtes de la terre, et personne ne [les] effraiera.
fr.B: Les cadavres de ce peuple deviendront la nourriture des oiseaux du ciel et des bêtes sauvages, et personne ne les chassera.
fr.R: Les oiseaux et les bêtes sauvages mangeront les cadavres de ces gens, et il n’y aura plus personne pour les chasser.

sw.L: Na mizoga ya watu hawa itakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na cha wanyama wa nchi, wala hakuna atakayewafukuza.
sw.B: Maiti za watu hawa zitakuwa chakula cha ndege wa angani na cha wanyama wa porini, wala hakuna atakayewafukuza.
sw.R: Ndege na wanyama wa porini watakula maiti za watu hawa, wala hakutabaki mtu wa kuwafukuza.

vi.L: Xác chết của dân này sẽ làm thức ăn cho chim trời và thú đồng, và không ai đuổi [chúng] đi.
vi.B: Xác chết của dân này sẽ làm mồi cho chim trời và thú hoang, và không ai xua đuổi chúng.
vi.R: Chim chóc và thú hoang sẽ ăn xác chết của dân này, và sẽ không còn ai xua đuổi chúng đi.

decisions.choice: food for the birds and the beasts, with no one to frighten them away: the curse of Deuteronomy 28:26
decisions.reason: The words repeat almost exactly the curse for breaking the covenant in Deuteronomy 28:26.

decisions.choice: corpses left unburied: the worst disgrace
decisions.reason: To lie unburied, eaten by animals, was the deepest shame (2 Samuel 21:10; 1 Kings 14:11). So many will die that no one will be left to bury them or drive the animals off.

decisions.choice: the sky (B); the birds (R)
decisions.reason: "Birds of the heavens" means wild birds; Balanced says "the sky" and Readable "the birds".

source.text: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י׀מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּמֵֽחֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְחָרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will make cease from [the] cities of Judah and from [the] streets of Jerusalem [the] sound of joy and [the] sound of gladness, [the] voice of bridegroom and [the] voice of bride; for to a ruin will become the land.

en.L: And I will make the sound of joy and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become a ruin.
en.B: In the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem I will silence the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bridegroom and bride, for the land will lie in ruins.
en.R: In the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, I will end the sounds of joy and happiness. No one will hear the happy voices of a bride and groom at their wedding. The whole land will become an empty ruin.

es.L: Y haré cesar de las ciudades de Judá y de las calles de Jerusalén la voz de gozo y la voz de alegría, la voz del novio y la voz de la novia, porque la tierra se convertirá en ruina.
es.B: En las ciudades de Judá y en las calles de Jerusalén haré callar los sonidos de gozo y de alegría, las voces del novio y de la novia, porque la tierra quedará en ruinas.
es.R: En los pueblos de Judá y en las calles de Jerusalén, pondré fin a los sonidos de gozo y felicidad. Nadie oirá las voces alegres de los novios en su boda. Toda la tierra se convertirá en una ruina vacía.

fr.L: Et je ferai cesser des villes de Juda et des rues de Jérusalem les cris de joie et les cris d’allégresse, la voix de l’époux et la voix de l’épouse, car le pays deviendra une ruine.
fr.B: Dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem, je ferai taire les cris de joie et d’allégresse, la voix du marié et la voix de la mariée, car le pays sera en ruine.
fr.R: Dans les villes de Juda et dans les rues de Jérusalem, je ferai cesser les bruits de joie et de bonheur. On n’entendra plus les voix joyeuses des mariés le jour de leurs noces. Tout le pays deviendra une ruine vide.

sw.L: Nami nitakomesha katika miji ya Yuda na katika njia za Yerusalemu sauti ya furaha na sauti ya shangwe, sauti ya bwana arusi na sauti ya bibi arusi, kwa maana nchi itakuwa magofu.
sw.B: Katika miji ya Yuda na njia za Yerusalemu nitazinyamazisha sauti za furaha na shangwe, sauti za bwana arusi na bibi arusi, kwa maana nchi itakuwa magofu.
sw.R: Katika miji ya Yuda na njia za Yerusalemu, nitazikomesha sauti za furaha na shangwe. Hakuna atakayesikia sauti za furaha za bibi arusi na bwana arusi katika arusi yao. Nchi yote itakuwa magofu matupu.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho tiếng vui mừng và tiếng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và tiếng cô dâu, dứt khỏi các thành Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì xứ sẽ trở nên hoang tàn.
vi.B: Trong các thành Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm im bặt tiếng vui mừng hân hoan, tiếng chàng rể và cô dâu, vì xứ sẽ trở nên hoang tàn.
vi.R: Trong các thành Giu-đa và các đường phố Giê-ru-sa-lem, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chấm dứt những tiếng vui mừng hớn hở. Sẽ không còn ai nghe tiếng cười nói của cô dâu chú rể trong ngày cưới. Cả xứ sẽ trở thành đống đổ nát hoang vắng.

decisions.choice: the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride: the joy of weddings, the sound of ordinary happy life
decisions.reason: Weddings were the most joyful celebrations of town life. Their silence means that normal life has ended. The same words return in 16:9 and 25:10, and the promise of their return in 33:10-11.

decisions.choice: God's speech does not end here; it runs on into 8:1-3
decisions.reason: The judgment on the dead continues in 8:1-3, which ends the temple sermon begun in 7:2.

decisions.choice: at their wedding
decisions.reason: Readable says where bride and groom are heard.
